jobs.title: Executive Search Program Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**Executive Search Program Coordinator (Contract Hourly) \- Hybrid**

  

Reporting to the Director of Global Executive Search, the Executive Search Program Coordinator plays a critical role in delivering a world\-class executive hiring experience. This individual serves as a trusted partner to the Executive Search team, senior leaders, executive assistants, candidates, and external search partners to ensure seamless execution of executive recruiting activities.


As the primary point of contact throughout the search process, you will represent Micron's Executive Search function and provide a high\-touch, white\-glove experience to executive\-level candidates. You will manage complex interview logistics, coordinate onboarding activities, support executive search operations, and drive strategic projects that enhance talent acquisition capabilities, processes, and candidate experience.


This role offers an opportunity to contribute beyond coordination by supporting talent mapping, market intelligence, executive talent pipelines, AI\-enabled recruiting initiatives, and process optimization projects that strengthen Micron's executive hiring strategy and future leadership pipeline.

**Executive Search Coordination \& Candidate Experience**

* Coordinate and manage all aspects of the executive recruiting lifecycle, including candidate scheduling, interview coordination, offer support, and onboarding activities.
* Deliver an exceptional, white\-glove candidate experience while maintaining the highest levels of confidentiality, professionalism, and responsiveness throughout the search process.
* Serve as the primary liaison between executive candidates, hiring leaders, executive assistants, recruiters, and external search firms.
* Ensure timely communication, follow\-up, and execution of critical search\-related activities to keep searches progressing efficiently.
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve complex logistical challenges involving multiple executives and stakeholders across global time zones.
* Support executive candidate travel, interview preparation, and onboarding activities to ensure a seamless experience from initial engagement through hire.

 **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Partner closely with Executive Leadership teams, Executive Assistants, Human Resources, and external search firms to facilitate successful search execution.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and executive search partners, ensuring a high standard of service delivery, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Maintain alignment among stakeholders and provide regular search progress updates throughout the recruiting process.
* Build strong relationships across the organization to ensure efficient coordination and positive experiences for candidates and hiring teams.

 **Operations \& Process Excellence**

* Maintain executive search dashboards, candidate trackers, reporting tools, and recruiting systems, including Workday and LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Ensure accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of candidate, search, and reporting data.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, best practices, search reports, presentations, and executive recruiting resources.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the overall executive recruiting experience.
* Support executive search reporting, metrics, and analytics to drive informed decision\-making and operational excellence.

 **Strategic Projects, Talent Intelligence \& Market Insights**

* Support executive talent mapping, talent pool development, benchmarking initiatives, and market intelligence research.
* Assist in creating executive talent market maps, succession\-focused talent pipelines, and competitive intelligence reports.
* Contribute to strategic projects focused on candidate experience, employer brand, executive recruiting capabilities, and process innovation.
* Assist with analytics, reporting, and insights that inform executive talent acquisition strategies, workforce planning, and succession planning efforts.

 **AI \& Recruiting Innovation**

* Leverage AI\-powered recruiting and productivity tools to improve search execution, candidate experience, research, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Support the development and adoption of AI\-enabled workflows for executive talent mapping, market intelligence, candidate engagement, benchmarking, and search project management.
* Partner with the Executive Search team to identify opportunities to automate administrative tasks, streamline processes, and enhance reporting through AI and digital solutions.
* Utilize AI tools to synthesize market insights, develop executive and company profiles, create presentations, and support executive search analytics.
* Act as a champion for innovation by helping the Executive Search team leverage emerging technologies to enhance talent identification, research, workflow automation, and candidate engagement.
* Maintain awareness of emerging recruiting technologies, AI capabilities, talent intelligence platforms, and industry best practices to continuously advance the effectiveness of the Executive Search function.

=========================



Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based consulting firm that delivers experienced field professionals to construction and utility organizations across the state. We partner with contractors, program owners, and utility clients to provide skilled inspection, construction management, and field support personnel who keep infrastructure projects safe, compliant, and on schedule.



Our team understands the demands of active construction environments, from underground gas and electric infrastructure to large\-scale utility programs. By pairing deep industry knowledge with a responsive, hands\-on approach, we help clients maintain quality, meet regulatory requirements, and keep field operations running smoothly on some of California's most critical infrastructure projects.

jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
  

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth\-focused environment for our people.
  
  

Job Summary
  
  

The Product Operations Lead is a part of the store leadership team responsible for executing on the store product strategy, including product operations and inventory management. They are responsible for leading inventory shifts, overseeing all back of house (BOH) product operations, and ensuring both the floor and BOH are stocked and well\-organized. The Product Operations Lead provides input to team member performance evaluations, recommendations into store hiring decisions, and acts as Supervisor on Duty (SOD) while leading inventory shifts. The Product Operations Lead also oversees and delivers a world\-class guest (i.e., customer) experience when scheduled to work on the floor.
  
  

Core Responsibilities of the Job
  
  

* Collaborate with store leadership to bring product strategy to life.
* Proactively plan, prioritize, manage, and lead inventory processing and accuracy activities in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure execution of product actions (e.g., pull backs, consolidations, repricing).
* Engage team members in inventory management by creating a fun and productive atmosphere for the shift.
* Monitor product levels and communicate findings to support sell\-through strategy and optimal product availability for the guest.
* Review and interpret daily business data and metrics to inform actions, for example analyzing product sell\-through data to provide recommendations to store leadership regarding product focus or, for outlets, pricing.
* Participate in the store's hiring process, including recruitment, selection and hiring recommendations, onboarding, and training.
* Address team member performance and support their ongoing learning and development by providing direct feedback and in\-the\-moment recognition, coaching, demonstrations, and hands\-on experiences.
* Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by establishing supportive working relationships with team members.
* When serving as Supervisor on Duty during store open hours, move dynamically and lead from the floor to ensure every guest receives technical product education and establish a world\-class guest experience.


Job Requirements
  
  

Eligibility
  
  

* Must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the store is located
* Must have the ability to travel to assigned store with reliable transportation methods


Schedule/Availability
  
  

* The work schedule can vary based on store needs
* Shifts are typically scheduled: mornings, afternoons, evenings, weekends, and holidays
* In addition, during peak timeframes, special events, or other circumstances, the schedule may include early mornings or late nights/overnights for some team members


Experience
  
  

* 1 year of work experience
* Some experience with inventory management, product or visual merchandising, stocking, or planning and logistics including using business technology to accomplish work
* Some experience in leading, mentoring, delegating or process implementation with others


Job Assets (i.e., nice to have; not required)
  
  

* Education: High school diploma/GED/equivalent, or above
* Experience (not necessarily the only focus of a role): retail, sales, distribution center, or warehouse operations related; reviewing and interpreting business reports and metrics to inform action
* For Experiential stores with food/beverage service only: Food safety and/or liquor service certification


What We Look For
  
  

* Inclusion \& Diversity: Creates/supports an inclusive environment that values/celebrates differences
* Integrity: Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner
* Adaptability/Agility: Navigates uncertainty and ambiguity and can change priorities in a fast\-paced environment; recovers quickly from setbacks
* Leadership: Is able and desires to lead and inspire others; motivates, empowers, develops, and directs people as they work
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Works productively with and supports others to achieve common goals; seeks connections, partnerships, and diverse perspectives
* Decision Making/Problem Solving: Identifies opportunities for improvement; evaluates alternatives and makes effective, timely decisions
* Planning and Organizing: Plans and organizes work in a clear and efficient manner to ensure completion in alignment with priorities
* Interactive Communication: Conveys information effectively and understands information shared while interacting with others


Work Context (e.g., environment, interactions, physical)
  
  

* Work involves moving through the store, sometimes in the front of the house with bright lights and loud music, and sometimes in the back of the house with no windows or natural light
* Work is accomplished as part of a team, sometimes independently, and sometimes using a computer or other technical devices
* Work may occasionally involve moving boxes weighing up to 30 lbs (13\.6 kg) or using ladders to reach materials
* For Experiential stores with food/beverage service only: Work may involve using industrial kitchen equipment and exposure to heat in order to prepare food or beverages

**Base Pay Range:** $24\.50 \- $28\.25/hour, subject to minimum wage in the location

jobs.description:
**Position Title:**
-------------------

Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant Project Manager
**Position Type:**
------------------

Regular
**Hiring Range:**
-----------------

$37\.31 \- $44\.79 per hour' *Compensation will be based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.*

**Pay Frequency:**
------------------

Hourly
A. POSITION PURPOSE


Under the supervision of the Sr. Assistant Dean / Chief Operating Officer and in close coordination with project co\-leads, the Project Manager provides administrative, operational, and tactical leadership for the implementation of the $10 Million Lilly Endowment Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant. This 5\-year grant project supports the launch and integration of the Pope Francis Institute for Pastoral Flourishing (PFI), the relocation and integration of JST\-SCU into Santa Clara University’s main campus, and the expansion of regional and national network partnerships.


The Project Manager serves as the primary operational engine driving daily grant activities. This position is responsible for ensuring all strategic deliverables, sub\-project timelines, inter\-departmental workflows, budget tracking, and official compliance reporting to the Lilly Endowment are executed seamlessly, accurately, and on schedule.


B. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


1\. Grant Project Management \& Operational Execution


* Serve as the central point of tactical execution, project tracking, and workflow management for all initiatives funded under the $10M Lilly LSC Grant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive master project plans, timelines, work breakdown structures, and milestone tracking frameworks across all grant components.
* Monitor day\-to\-day progress across project working groups, internal SCU departments (JST, GPPM, Religious Studies), and external collaborating partners.
* Manage the operational roadmap for Year 1 ("Year of Co\-Design"), coordinating inter\-departmental task forces, curriculum alignment teams, and committee deliverables.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, risks, or schedule deviations, implementing corrective action plans to maintain project momentum.

2\. Centralized Compliance, Financial Tracking \& Grant Reporting


* Manage overall compliance with Lilly Endowment Grant Agreement terms, conditions, and reporting requirements.
* Partner closely with SCU Office of Sponsored Projects (SPO), JST Finance, and University Development to monitor the $10M budget, track expenditure allocations, approve line\-item disbursements, and manage sub\-award contracts.
* Coordinate, write, and submit all annual narrative program reports and collaborate with the SPO to submit financial reports to the Lilly Endowment by established deadlines.
* Collect, aggregate, and verify project data, revenue match metrics, and qualitative/quantitative outcomes from constituent units (such as CLTM, PFI, and external partner networks) for centralized reporting.
* Oversee budget revision requests and line\-item reallocations in accordance with Lilly Endowment policy guidelines.

3\. Stakeholder Coordination \& Governance Support


* Facilitate regular communication, meeting schedules, documentation, and reporting streams for the Grant Steering Committee, Advisory Boards, and Working Groups.
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal academic units and external partner organizations (e.g., ACHTUS, RECOSS, Iskali, regional dioceses, Discerning Deacons), managing partner contracts, stipends, and joint project deliverables.
* Maintain central project repositories, shared documentation, communications archives, and collaborative platforms (e.g., Google Workspace/Drive) to ensure transparent governance.

4\. Communications, Dissemination \& Logistics


* Coordinate the execution of project events, national symposia, planning retreats, workshops, and advisory council meetings in collaboration with project staff.
* Implement the grant’s strategic communication and dissemination plan, sharing project insights, best practices, and research outputs with national theological networks and peer institutions.
* Maintain systematic evaluation data and performance indicators to measure long\-term institutional impact and pastoral reach.

5\. Other duties as assigned in support of JST’s mission and operational needs


C. PROVIDES WORK DIRECTION


May at times, directly supervise grant\-funded project personnel, logistics coordinators, and graduate student assistants. Provides cross\-functional project direction and milestone tracking for grant task force leads across partner departments.


D. GENERAL GUIDELINES


Establishes robust project tracking systems and monitors task completion across multiple independent workstreams.


Identifies operational risks early and formulates actionable recommendations for project leads and committee chairs.


Maintains continuous communication with internal SCU administrators, external partners, and grant officers.


Ensures strict adherence to institutional accounting policies, grant agreement terms, and federal/foundation compliance regulations.


Prepares comprehensive progress dashboards and status briefs for executive leadership.


E. QUALIFICATIONS


1\. Knowledge


* Thorough understanding of formal project management methodologies, lifecycle frameworks, and grant administration tools.
* Familiarity with private foundation grant administration (experience with Lilly Endowment grants or higher education sponsored programs highly preferred).
* Understanding of university organizational structures, academic administration, and multi\-institutional collaborative networks.
* Knowledge of Catholic ecclesiology, ministerial formation, and the pastoral realities in the United States preferred.
* Strong understanding of the values, ideals, and mission of Jesuit higher education and the Jesuit School of Theology preferred.
* Knowledge of ATS\-accredited graduate theological education preferred.

jobs.description:
**Customer Care Representative**

  

**We are Lennar**

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for our Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

  

  

**A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future**

  

The Customer Care Representative is a key member of the Lennar Customer Care Team, providing warranty and service support to Homeowners through digital channels. The role is dedicated to enhancing Customer Satisfaction by responding to Homeowner service requests quickly and professionally using remote assessment, digital communication, and virtual technology. Clear and proactive communication with Homeowners, field teams, and Trade Partners is essential for timely and effective issue resolution.  



  

**Your Responsibilities on the Team**

* Professionally and promptly handle requests by contacting the Homeowner after reviewing provided documentation, homesite and case history to ensure familiarity with the matter.

* Document and maintain all findings, including pertinent documents, photos, and correspondence using provided technology to ensure thorough case documentation.
* Determine the scope of work for warranty repairs, troubleshoot and resolve minor issues remotely, and coordinate with Trade Partners for further action.
* Ensure repairs are completed and Homeowners are satisfied through knowledgeable, friendly, and proactive support.
* Deliver comprehensive support in accordance with Lennar’s warranty policies and quality standards.
* Process back charges and EPOs to ensure prompt payment of Trade Partners as needed.
* Proactively remedy any trade partner scheduling, communication, or payment related issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned to support the overall success of the division.

The Advanced Medical Support Assistant (AMSA) in the San Francisco VA Healthcare System Call Center serves as part of an interprofessional healthcare team. AMSA provides support across multiple ancillary and interprofessional clinics and determines the needs of the Veteran/caregiver. The AMSA plays an integral role in achieving first\-contact resolution through Veteran\-centered delivery of care.

**Work Location Type:** On\-Site  

**Salary Range:** $75,000\.00 \- 85,000\.00


**About us**
------------


Since 1942, SkyChefs has taken culinary excellence to new heights. As a trusted partner to the nation’s leading airlines and retailers, we proudly deliver millions of meals and exceptional service experiences every year across 43 sites throughout the United States. Built on a legacy of operational excellence, culinary expertise, and continuous innovation, we are committed to setting the industry standard in aviation culinary, airline services, last\-mile logistics, and retail commerce. From the kitchen to the runway, our teams work together to deliver quality, reliability, and service at every altitude. Our people are the heart of everything we do. --------------------------



The Equipment \& Sanitation (E\&S) Supervisor is responsible for overseeing equipment flow and deliveries to all departments, ensuring equipment is cleaned properly and delivered in a timely manner. We are seeking a proactive leader who can balance people management, operational execution, and sanitation compliance while ensuring equipment availability and workflow efficiency across the operation.

-------------------------

* Supervise, train, and schedule E\&S production staff to meet daily output goals.
* Monitor inventory levels, order supplies, and ensure proper maintenance of equipment.
* Identify bottlenecks, document processes, and implement improvements to enhance efficiency.
* Oversee the equipment and sanitation operations, maintaining quality control, and ensuring on\-time delivery
* Run daily huddles to keep everyone focused and energized
* Enforce strict adherence to HACCP, FDA, USDA, and OSHA regulations, ensuring proper temperature controls and hygiene.
* Optimize staffing and schedules to hit productivity and cost goals
* Implement innovative solutions to improve workflow and reduce waste
* Ensure every flight is catered accurately and on schedule
* Jump in on special projects and company initiatives to make an impact
* Motivate, coach, and develop your team while living our company values

* Guide, motivate and develop staff within the Human Resources policies
* Make the company's values and management principles live in the department(s)

------------------------------------


* 1\-3\+ years in a food production environment
* Strong understanding of HACCP protocols, and food safety regulations.

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About** **Nooks.ai****:**
===========================


Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from *account strategy* to *prospect research* and *outreach*. Building 0 1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.


Today, over 1,500 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We’ve raised $70M\+ from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, which made its first sales\-tech investment in over a decade with us. Since then, we’ve tripled ARR each year for 3 years running and grown a high\-caliber team turning the art of sales into a scalable science.

**Recruiting Operations Manager**
=================================


Nook's is looking for a Recruiting Operations Manager to help build the systems, programs, and infrastructure that enable our recruiting organization to scale.


This is a highly cross\-functional, high\-ownership role for someone who loves making things better. You’ll sit at the intersection of Recruiting, People, Marketing, and the broader business — using data, technology, AI, and strong program management to improve how we attract, engage, and hire great talent.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

### **1\. Recruiting Operations**

* Own recruiting processes, reporting, analytics, and operating rhythms.
* Turn recruiting data into insights and actionable improvements.
* Manage and optimize our recruiting technology and vendor ecosystem, including security, billing, adoption, and training.
* Research and implement new tools and technologies that improve recruiter productivity and candidate experience.
* Drive the adoption of AI across recruiting, including evaluating new use cases and implementing Nooks Agent.
* Lead strategic research projects to help us make better, data\-driven recruiting decisions.
* Help develop and strengthen Nooks’ recruiting/employer brand and equip the team with consistent messaging and tools.
* Create leverage across the recruiting team through better systems, automation, processes, and team enablement.

### **2\. Talent Events \& Programs**


Own or support talent\-focused events and programs that strengthen Nooks’ brand and talent pipeline, including:

* Hackathons and technical events
* Conferences and industry events
* Nooks\-hosted events and dinners
* University and community events
* Creative new ways to get Nooks in front of exceptional talent


Partner cross\-functionally with Marketing, Recruiting, Engineering, and other teams to maximize the impact of these efforts.

### **3\. People Operations Partnership**


Partner with People Operations to ensure Recruiting and People processes scale together.


You’ll help:

* Implement and communicate new processes effectively.
* Identify when teams need training, documentation, or enablement.
* Improve cross\-functional workflows and eliminate operational friction.
* Support strategic People projects where your expertise can create leverage.

### **4\. University Programs**


Own and accelerate Nooks’ university recruiting strategy, with a particular focus on engineering talent.


You’ll build relationships with universities and technical communities, develop programs and events, measure results, and create a scalable pipeline of exceptional early\-career talent. You’ll partner with recruiters and hiring teams as needed while maintaining ownership of the overall program.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience in Recruiting Operations, Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting, Program Management, or a similar function.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Experience building processes or programs from the ground up.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI and emerging recruiting technology.
* Ability to manage systems, vendors, and multiple cross\-functional initiatives.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* A bias toward action and a willingness to operate in ambiguity.
* Someone who naturally looks for ways to create leverage, automate work, and make teams better.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


You’ll make Nooks’ recruiting organization **more scalable, data\-driven, technology\-enabled, and effective**.


You’ll help us spend less time on manual work, make better decisions with better data, get more value from our technology, build a stronger talent brand, create new talent pipelines, and give the recruiting team the leverage they need to focus on what they do best: **hiring exceptional people.**

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
------------------------------------------


Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

jobs.title: Financial Partnerships Operations Manager, Americas
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

**About the team**
------------------


The Financial Partnerships Operations team supports smooth day\-to\-day collaboration with Airwallex’s banking partners across our global entities. We work closely with Financial Partnerships Managers, external financial institutions, and internal teams to improve processes, manage partner requirements, support new market expansion, and deliver high\-impact results across Airwallex’s products.

**What you'll do**
------------------


Reporting to the Director, Partnerships Strategy \& Operations, you will help support the day\-to\-day operations of the Financial Partnerships team and the continued growth of the organisation. You will play a significant role in our communications with external banking and financial partners, while helping ensure compliance with applicable regulations and maintaining the trust of our customers and stakeholders.


You will work with teams and partners across Airwallex’s product offerings, including Issuing, Online Payments, and Global Treasury \& Payment Network. This is an opportunity to join a growing team, improve how we operate at scale, and help shape the next phase of Airwallex’s global growth.


This role is based in New York, NY.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with the Financial Partnerships team as Airwallex expands into new markets and grows its network of banking, payment, and financial\-institution partners.
* Support the operational relationship with financial partners throughout their lifecycle with Airwallex, from onboarding and due diligence through integration, launch, steady state, and expansion.
* Track prevailing rules, regulations, scheme requirements, and upcoming changes affecting banks, payment service providers, card schemes, and alternative payment methods.
* Develop continuous process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness. This may involve building new processes, streamlining existing workflows, leveraging technology, and implementing best practices.
* Own the triage of partner escalations, operational requests, and internal dependencies, ensuring issues are routed to the right teams and resolved in a timely manner against agreed KPIs.
* Coordinate regular due diligence sessions with Financial Crime Compliance and other relevant control functions, ensuring partner requirements are understood, documented, and completed on time.
* Partner with financial institutions on change management, ensuring new releases, scheme requirements, regulatory changes, and partner requests are executed properly by Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Generate and present reports to senior management and financial partners, providing clear visibility into partner health, implementation progress, operational risks, and areas for improvement.
* Contribute to scalable operating mechanisms, including partner scorecards, governance forums, QBRs, intake processes, playbooks, and performance dashboards.

**Who you are**
---------------


We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* At least 4 years of experience in financial services, fintech, payments, banking operations, strategy, business operations, partnerships, consulting, or a related field. Experience in a fast\-growing technology company or top\-tier financial institution is preferred.
* Strong project\-management experience, with a track record of improving processes, policies, products, or operational workflows.

* The ability to think critically and creatively while balancing growth, customer experience, operational effectiveness, and risk.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.


At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.


A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We’re looking for an International Operations Manager to drive and manage the operational cadence supporting our international structure across local country teams. You will spearhead cross\-functional execution, lead end\-to\-end work item and resource planning, and operationalize group reporting, goal\-setting, and performance tracking. In this role, you’ll build, own, and optimize the rhythms (such as QBRs, regular business reviews, and scorecards) that keep global workstreams aligned, resourced, and delivered on schedule.



This full\-time, hybrid (in\-office on Tues/Wed/Thurs) position is based in our San Mateo office and reports to the Head of International Strategy \& Ops.


### **You Will:**

* **Lead Cadence \& Operating Rhythms:** Spearhead and own internal operating cadences and reporting, including leading quarterly business reviews, establishing regular review rhythms with local international teams, and driving core alignment across regions.
* **Work Item \& Resource Planning:** Lead work item prioritization, project planning, and resource allocation across cross\-functional teams (Marketing, Comms, Trust \& Safety, Business Development, Finance, Legal) to ensure local market initiatives are properly scoped and supported.
* **Execution Management:** Oversee master project plans, timelines, and resource dependencies, actively driving follow\-ups and hold owners accountable to keep all global deliverables on track.
* Define and track core operational performance metrics and resource utilization, creating executive reporting for leadership.
* Gather inputs from country teams and XFN partners and synthesize into clear status updates, risks, and next steps.
* Lead recurring operational cadences (regional check\-ins, QBR prep, scorecards, resource allocation, and annual/quarterly planning cycles).
* Identify recurring operational gaps and implement process improvements
* Maintain and improve playbooks for repeatable workflows within local country teams across the world
* Serve as an operational point of contact between country teams and HQ partners for planning, execution, and issue triage.
* Coordinate with external vendors/agencies as needed
* Flag execution risks early (dependencies, resourcing, approvals, timelines) and help coordinate escalations to the right owners.
* Partner with Legal/Compliance/Trust \& Safety to ensure required steps are followed for market initiatives.

### **You Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years** of experience in operations, program management, business operations, or cross\-functional project coordination.
* Experience supporting international or multi\-region teams is a plus.
* Strong project management fundamentals (planning, tracking, risk management, stakeholder updates).
* Comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize and simplify.
* Analytical and organized, with strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Familiarity with tooling such as spreadsheets, dashboards, and project trackers (e.g., Airtable, Asana/Jira) is a plus.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations Manager at Project Artaud

Reports to: Matrix structure including Executive Committee and Senior Bookkeeper  
Status: Part\-time, non\-exempt  
Compensation: $36\-45 per hour, commensurate with experience  
Benefits: Paid Sick leave, vacation/holiday pay, health insurance support, 401k plan

Hours \& Schedule: Estimated 30 hours per week across a 5\-day work week  
Location: On\-site at Project Artaud, San Francisco

ORGANIZATIONAL OVERVIEW

Project Artaud is a community\-governed artist live/work 501(c)(3\) membership organization in San Francisco dedicated to providing long\-term, low\-cost place for artists and cultural workers. The organization supports a diverse membership of resident artists and oversees a complex historic facility that requires consistent operational, administrative, and facilities coordination.

The Operations Manager plays a central role in ensuring that Project Artaud functions smoothly as both a community and an organization by overseeing daily operations, coordinating facilities\-related administration, supporting human resources and governance processes, and serving as a key point of contact for members, vendors, and partners.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Operations Manager is responsible for the coordination and administration of Project Artaud’s day\-to\-day organizational and facilities operations.

The Operations Manager works closely with the Facilities Administrator and Bookkeeper to ensure effective communication, compliance, documentation, and continuity of operations across the organization.

This position serves as a central hub for:

* Member communications and requests
* Facilities coordination and record\-keeping
* Organizational administration
* Human resources processes
* Office and systems management

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

General Operations \& Administration

* Serve as a primary point of contact for Project Artaud members, vendors, and external partners regarding operational and administrative matters
* Maintain regular office hours and ensure consistent organizational presence
* Attend at least on evening Board meeting per month
* Manage organizational calendars, schedules, and internal communications
* Receive, distribute, and track mail, deliveries, notices, and official communications
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems for:
* Membership records
* Board and committee documents
* Volunteer tracking
* Administrative and legal files
* Policies and procedures
* Support preparation and distribution of agendas, notices, ballots, and meeting materials for Board and Committee meetings
* Maintain confidentiality of organizational and member information
* Provide logistical support for organizational meetings and events
* Serve as the main liaison for all insurance related matters, both general liability and worker's comp and the organization’s interlocutor with the insurance broker

Facilities \& Systems Coordination (in collaboration with Facilities Administrator)

* Coordinate with the Facilities Administrator and Facilities Maintenance Manager on:
* Work order tracking and documentation
* Vendor scheduling and site access
* Emergency response coordination
* Maintain and organize records for:
* Permits and inspections
* Fire and life safety systems
* Emergency procedures
* Equipment and systems manuals
* Maintain vendor files, contracts, and service histories
* Support communication with members regarding facilities updates, construction projects, and service interruptions
* Assist with key control, space access systems (e.g., lock outs, site visits), and security coordination
* Maintain office systems, equipment, and basic IT infrastructure (computers, printers, shared drives, databases, email accounts)

Member Services \& Communications

* Respond to member inquiries related to operations, policies, and procedures
* Facilitate communication between members and appropriate committees or staff
* Coordinate access to office resources and systems
* Support internal communications such as newsletters, notices, and announcements
* Maintain bulletin boards, members\-only website, and shared information systems

Financial \& Administrative Coordination (non\-bookkeeping)

(In coordination with the Senior Bookkeeper and Treasurer)

* Gather and organize documentation for accounts payable and receivable
* Track and route invoices and purchase orders for approval
* Assist with preparation of reports and information requests
* Support annual audits and required filings through record organization
* Ensure financial procedures are followed (without performing bookkeeping functions)
* Perform additional administrative duties as directed by the Executive Committee

Systems, Documentation \& Continuous Improvement

* Maintain and update operations manuals and procedures
* Maintain and manage software subscriptions and updates
* Identify opportunities to improve internal systems, workflows, and recordkeeping
* Support implementation of new operational tools and platforms
* Train staff and committee members on operational systems as needed

QUALIFICATIONS

* Strong organizational and administrative skills with attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills with diverse stakeholders
* Experience in nonprofit, cooperative, or community\-based organizations preferred
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
* Comfort working with digital systems including Google Drive, One Drive, Microsoft 365, email, spreadsheets, shared databases, project management software
* Interest in facilities operations and building systems
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
* Collaborative, service\-oriented mindset
* Passion for supporting artists and community\-based organizations

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

* Ability to perform office\-based work
* Some walking throughout the building on concrete floors with stairs
* On\-call availability for emergencies in coordination with Facilities staff

**DOCUMENT REVIEW \& LEGAL SUPPORT OPERATIONS MANAGER**

**ABOUT US**

We are a boutique law firm based in Pleasanton, CA. The majority of our work is defense\-side employment litigation, representing mostly public\-entities.

**ABOUT THE JOB**

All applicants must be California\-certified Paralegals, although the scope of this job is predominantly managerial.

This opportunity is for an on\-site, full\-time manager overseeing the project management of large\-scale document reviews, including preservation and initial preparation of documents for review, oversite of approximately five review personnel and interfacing with attorneys to determine the proper scope of the project, and assisting in determining which items are critical to identify in the review process. Critical to this role is also overseeing and verifying the accurate redaction of sensitive information, particularly in medical and employment environments.

Additionally, this position will oversee a small Legal Support Department, responsible for calendaring, filing and accurately maintaining paper and electronic case files, subpoenas and trial preparation. Experience with creating and maintaining standardized litigation support practices and procedures, with a focus on improving accuracy and consistency.

· Ability to work with senior management to prioritize projects and to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office and recent experience working in an Apple macOS environment.

· Must be authorized to work permanently in the United States (i.e. either U.S. citizen or green\-card holder).

jobs.title: Silicon Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Etched**
================


Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Production Planning \& Scheduling**
-------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain end\-to\-end production schedules for silicon wafers, interposers, and test/assembly, supporting phases from engineering builds to mass production.
* Coordinate with foundries, OSATs (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test providers), and internal stakeholders to ensure production milestones and quality goals are met.
* Collaborate with test engineering teams to coordinate ATE test program development, bring\-up planning, and bench validation hardware readiness.
* Track and forecast capacity planning across all silicon manufacturing stages, including wafer fabrication, component procurement, assembly, and test.

**Supply Chain Coordination**
-----------------------------

* Manage the procurement, delivery, and scheduling of key silicon components (e.g., wafers, interposers, substrates) to ensure optimal time\-to\-market.
* Act as the operational lead between internal teams and suppliers, ensuring transparency and alignment across silicon, packaging, validation, and manufacturing.
* Prepare for mass production ramp by ensuring material readiness, test infrastructure availability, and logistic support to mitigate bottlenecks or delays.

**Forecasting \& Reporting**
----------------------------

* Build and maintain demand forecasts for silicon and related components, based on build plans, yield assumptions, validation schedules, and market dynamics.
* Share regular forecasts with supply chain partners and ensure proactive capacity allocation at foundries and OSATs.
* Generate and maintain detailed dashboards and reports to track schedule adherence, capacity utilization, inventory status, and delivery performance for executive and technical stakeholders.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
=====================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in supply chain management, production planning, or operations within the semiconductor industry.
* Deep understanding of the silicon lifecycle: tape\-out, fabrication, packaging, test, bring\-up, and validation
* Proven track record working with foundries (TSMC, Samsung, etc.) and OSATs (ASE, Amkor, JCET, etc.).
* Willingness to travel up to 25% for onsite supplier engagement, engineering builds, and production ramp support.
* Strong understanding of: Silicon manufacturing processes, including wafer fabrication, dicing, bumping, CoWoS packaging, and testing;
* Proficiency in using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel skills or analytics tools.
* Experience with hardware validation cycles and managing silicon hardware logistics.
* Exceptional program management and organizational skills with the ability to handle complex timelines and interdependencies.
* Effective communicator and cross\-functional leader across engineering, validation, and operations teams.

**Strong candidates may also have**
===================================

* Experience working on advanced process nodes (e.g., 5nm, 3nm).
* Familiarity with ATE platforms (Teradyne, Advantest) and test program infrastructure.
* Prior experience managing silicon bring\-up in hyperscale computing, AI/ML, or high\-performance SoC environments.
* PMP certification or equivalent project/program management training.
* Familiarity with CoWoS or other 2\.5D/3D packaging technologies.

**Benefits**

* Full medical, dental, and vision packages, with generous premium coverage
* Housing subsidy of **$2,500/month** for those living within walking distance of the office
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

**How we’re different**


Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model\-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single\-model ASICs.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

jobs.title: International Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.



At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.



A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for an International Operations Manager to drive and manage the operational cadence supporting our international structure across local country teams. You will spearhead cross\-functional execution, lead end\-to\-end work item and resource planning, and operationalize group reporting, goal\-setting, and performance tracking. In this role, you'll build, own, and optimize the rhythms (such as QBRs, regular business reviews, and scorecards) that keep global workstreams aligned, resourced, and delivered on schedule.



This full\-time, hybrid (in\-office on Tues/Wed/Thurs) position is based in our San Mateo office and reports to the Head of International Strategy \& Ops.


### **You Will:**

* **Lead Cadence \& Operating Rhythms:** Spearhead and own internal operating cadences and reporting, including leading quarterly business reviews, establishing regular review rhythms with local international teams, and driving core alignment across regions.
* **Work Item \& Resource Planning:** Lead work item prioritization, project planning, and resource allocation across cross\-functional teams (Marketing, Comms, Trust \& Safety, Business Development, Finance, Legal) to ensure local market initiatives are properly scoped and supported.
* **Execution Management:** Oversee master project plans, timelines, and resource dependencies, actively driving follow\-ups and hold owners accountable to keep all global deliverables on track.
* Define and track core operational performance metrics and resource utilization, creating executive reporting for leadership.
* Gather inputs from country teams and XFN partners and synthesize into clear status updates, risks, and next steps.
* Lead recurring operational cadences (regional check\-ins, QBR prep, scorecards, resource allocation, and annual/quarterly planning cycles).
* Identify recurring operational gaps and implement process improvements
* Maintain and improve playbooks for repeatable workflows within local country teams across the world
* Serve as an operational point of contact between country teams and HQ partners for planning, execution, and issue triage.
* Coordinate with external vendors/agencies as needed
* Flag execution risks early (dependencies, resourcing, approvals, timelines) and help coordinate escalations to the right owners.
* Partner with Legal/Compliance/Trust \& Safety to ensure required steps are followed for market initiatives.

### **You Have:**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years** of experience in operations, program management, business operations, or cross\-functional project coordination.
* Experience supporting international or multi\-region teams is a plus.
* Strong project management fundamentals (planning, tracking, risk management, stakeholder updates).
* Comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize and simplify.
* Analytical and organized, with strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Familiarity with tooling such as spreadsheets, dashboards, and project trackers (e.g., Airtable, Asana/Jira) is a plus.


Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

jobs.description:
**Job Title/Code:** Operations Manager

**Department**: Operations


**Reports To:** Vice President Operations


**Job Type:** Exempt **Location:** Concord, CA, 100% onsite




At EMCORE LLC, we're committed to attracting and nurturing diverse, high\-performing talent who are passionate about their work. Our employees share a common purpose\-supporting our customers' missions while pursuing their own professional growth. We foster an inclusive and engaging workplace culture where innovation, collaboration, and work\-life balance thrive. Core to our values is a steadfast commitment to excellence, community engagement, and integrity in everything we do.




**About EMCORE LLC**


EMCORE LLC is a leading independent provider of advanced inertial navigation solutions for the aerospace, defense, commercial, and industrial sectors. As pioneers in fiber optic gyros and Quartz MEMS technologies, we drive innovation across a wide range of navigation applications.

**Position Summary:**


The Operations Manager oversees and manages daily manufacturing operations within an aerospace production environment manufacturing quartz MEMS (QMEMS), ensuring products are built safely, efficiently, and to stringent quality standards. This role focuses on operational excellence, continuous improvement, resource planning, and leading cross\-functional teams to meet customer, regulatory, and organizational requirements and will be instrumental in driving yield improvement within a highly complex operating environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage daytoday production activities across assigned manufacturing areas and report daily through Business Unit Team meetings on shipments progress.
* Develop and manage staffing plans, shift schedules, labor allocation, and skills training.
* Ensure compliance with aerospace industry standards, regulations, and certifications (such as AS9100, ISO 9001\).
* Drive throughput, productivity, and cost improvements while maintaining quality and safety in alignment with Business Unit objectives.
* Implement and sustain productivity efforts, process optimization, and wastereduction initiatives in support of annual plan CapEx and productivity targets and timelines.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Program Management to support production readiness and resolve issues.
* Develop, implement, monitor, and adapt KPIs such as ontime delivery, scrap/rework, cycle time, customer satisfaction, safety metrics, and labor efficiency.
* In partnership with Quality, lead rootcause analysis and corrective actions for production challenges, quality escapes, or process deviations.
* Manage production equipment, tooling needs, preventive maintenance priorities, and facility support requirements.
* Support development, planning, and execution for new product introductions, process changes, and technology upgrades.
* Prepare operations reports and present performance updates to leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of supervision and or management experience in aerospace, defense, or complex precision electronics manufacturing.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 aerospace or similar quality standards, production documentation, process controls, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate teams, manage priorities, and solve problems in a fastpaced production environment.
* Ability to manage and analyze data to support strategic operational decisions.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. (U.S. citizenship or Permanent Resident).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.).
* Formal lean or Six Sigma certification.
* Experience with quartz\-based MEMS or inertial sensor products (gyroscopes and accelerometers).
* Experience with cleanroom environments (ISO Class 5\-8\).
* Background in highmix / lowvolume aerospace production environments.
* This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that an employee in this position may be asked to perform from time to time. EMCORE LLC reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

**Salary:**


The position offers a salary range of $140 \- $175K annually, depending on the candidate's experience, skill set, and overall qualifications.




* **As a federal contractor, we are required to have all candidates offered employment to pass a criminal background check prior to starting employment.**




**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

*Separate from employment eligibility (Form I\-9\), US export license requirements may apply before the Company can provide certain non\- "U.S. persons" with access to specific technology, software, and hardware that may be necessary for a position. As such, this position may require ITAR or EAR clearance, consistent with the U.S. citizenship or Permanent Resident requirement stated above.*




*EMCORE LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Claims Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About 8Fleet**
----------------


8Fleet is a Los Angeles–based technology and logistics company building the operational infrastructure behind modern rideshare fleets. We operate in Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Atlanta and Miami, with more markets launching soon.

**About the Role**
------------------


At 8Fleet, claims sit at the intersection of fleet availability, driver experience, insurance costs, repair expenses, operational risk and company economics. Today our accident and vehicle\-incident claims run largely on manual workflows in Google Sheets. You'll manage those claims directly while building the claims function from the ground up: the processes, the standards and the reporting that turn claims data into decisions that save money.


This role sits on our Central Operations team and is based in Los Angeles or San Francisco.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own accident and vehicle\-incident claims across all markets, from first notice of loss through investigation, repair coordination, negotiation, settlement and closure.
* Build the incident intake and triage process, including what happens in the first 24 hours.
* Be the main contact for carriers, TPAs, adjusters and defense counsel, and hold them to clear expectations.
* Run subrogation and recovery as a real workstream.
* Partner with market leaders to turn accident trends and risk patterns into operational changes.
* Build claims reporting leadership can plan against: frequency, severity, cost per vehicle and open\-claim aging.
* Move claims onto a proper system and support insurance renewals with clean loss data.
* Keep us compliant with state requirements in CA, GA, FL and each new market.
* Build the team as volume grows.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 7\+ years in auto, fleet, transportation or commercial auto claims, including owning a claims function or program end to end.
* Experience with third\-party liability and bodily injury claims.
* Strong claim\-file judgment and experience working with TPAs and defense counsel.
* Confidence pushing back on carriers on reserves and coverage.
* Multi\-state experience, ideally including California.
* A methodical approach and comfort building process where none exists.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* AIC, SCLA, ARM or similar designation.
* Self\-insured or large\-deductible program experience.
* Fleet, rideshare, delivery or logistics background.
* People\-management experience.

**Compensation**
----------------


Base Salary: $130,000–$150,000 \+ equity

jobs.description:
Description:

If you're passionate about restoring California's natural landscapes and want to be involved in the entire restoration process from concept through implementation and long\-term success, this is an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact. As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you'll help lead and grow HELIX's expanding habitat restoration practice in Northern California while working alongside a team that designs, builds, monitors, and maintains restoration projects entirely in\-house.

**Why HELIX?**


At HELIX Environmental Planning, we take pride in delivering innovative environmental solutions that make a meaningful difference. Our team works on diverse public and private sector projects across California, from coastal habitats to mountain ecosystems and the Central Valley. What sets HELIX apart is our ability to handle every stage of habitat restoration under one roof, from planning and permitting to plant propagation, field implementation, and biological monitoring. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** role offers a unique chance to join a growing Northern California team and help shape the future of our restoration services. We offer a flexible hybrid work schedule with a combination of in\-office and remote work.

**Day in the Life**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, no two days are the same. * Develop habitat restoration plans and support environmental permitting efforts.
* Assist with restoration grant applications and project development.
* Conduct and oversee biological surveys, vegetation mapping, and special\-status species surveys.
* Lead biological monitoring for restoration and construction projects.
* Support wetland permit applications and regulatory documentation.
* Participate in business development, proposal preparation, and project interviews.
* Travel occasionally overnight as project needs require.

**Compensation**


Salary will be based on qualifications and/or experience, with a robust benefits package. Expected starting pay range of **$130,000 to $160,000**.

**Ready to Grow Your Career?**


If you're an experienced **Senior Restoration Project Manager** looking to advance habitat restoration throughout Northern California while helping build and grow a thriving restoration program, we'd love to hear from you. HELIX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and an inclusive work environment. Qcells is seeking a Program Manager to join EnFin's Enterprise Planning \& PMO function and will report to the Director of Strategy \& Program Management. Beyond project delivery, you will support business development and contribute to building our resilience practice.

  

  

What You'll Do:


* Project Delivery: Manage delivery of resilience and flood risk projects across planning, design, and construction phases, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and QA/QC. Oversee multidisciplinary project teams spanning engineering, environmental, and planning disciplines. Mentor and develop junior staff across technical and project management capabilities.
* Engineering Team Interface: Coordinate engineering teams through design development, review deliverables, and interpret hydraulic modeling, flood risk analysis, and coastal engineering outputs to inform project decisions and communicate findings to decision\-makers and public audiences.
* Interagency Coordination and Community Engagement: Lead coordination with public agency clients, city departments, and federal, state, and regional partners. Support community engagement and co\-design processes that center equity and ensure project outcomes reflect community priorities alongside technical and environmental performance.
* Resilience and Adaptation Strategy: Contribute to vulnerability assessments, flood risk analyses, and adaptation strategy development. Support development and evaluation of adaptation alternatives using frameworks that consider hazard reduction, equity, environmental performance, social value, cost, and implementation feasibility – across a range of adaptation project, program, and policy options.
* Communication and Public Presentation: Prepare briefings, decision memos, technical summaries, and presentations for senior leadership, elected officials, regulatory bodies, and public audiences. Deliver public presentations to community groups, stakeholder forums, and interagency audiences.
* Business Development and Practice Building: Support pursuit of new project opportunities through proposal development and client relationship building. Contribute to growing the resilience and adaptation practice through thought leadership and cross\-project collaboration.
  

  

\#LI\-AC2


Here's what you'll need
* Bachelor's degree in Geography, Environmental Science, Urban Planning, Environmental Management, Public Policy, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in flood risk management, climate adaptation, coastal resilience, or related infrastructure and environmental program delivery.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary project teams to coordinate technical delivery, review engineering and design outputs, and maintain QA/QC standards.
* Experience working with public agency clients and coordinating across multiple government agencies and stakeholders in complex urban or infrastructure settings.
* Ability to communicate complex technical information to senior decision\-makers, elected officials, and public audiences, including delivering public presentations.
* Familiarity with flood risk assessment, sea level rise, coastal hazards, or climate adaptation planning frameworks sufficient to engage with and direct technical teams.
  
  

Ideally, you'll also have:


* Master's degree in Climate Science, Environmental Policy, Urban Planning, Water Resources, Coastal Management, or related field.
* Project management credentials (PMP or equivalent) or professional credentials in environmental or water management (e.g., CFM, ENV SP).
* Experience with large\-scale flood defense, waterfront resilience, or coastal adaptation programs, including oversight of engineering design development from concept through construction.
* Familiarity with adaptation pathways approaches, including weaving governance structures, funding mechanisms, and institutional decision\-making into physical adaptation strategies.
* Experience helping clients structure phased investments that respond to evolving conditions.
* Experience with nature\-based solutions, multi\-criteria evaluation of adaptation alternatives, benefit\-cost analysis, or business case development for public infrastructure investment.
* Experience with equity\-focused analysis, social vulnerability assessment, social value frameworks, or community co\-design in the context of resilience or infrastructure planning.
* Experience with spatial planning, urban design, and/or landscape approaches for integrating adaptation measures into multibenefit improvements.
* Understanding of relevant regulatory frameworks, which may include USACE Section 408/NEPA, CEQA, BCDC, or FEMA floodplain management.

Product

**Why Harvey**
==============


At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.


This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.


Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.


At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


**Role Overview**
=================


Harvey ships fast, and our customers tell us constantly what's working and what isn't — through CSMs, support, sales, and early\-access programs. Today that signal lives in a hundred places and reaches Product inconsistently, and the systems that let the EPD organization plan, review, and fix things at scale are still being built. You will own those systems: a single Voice of the Customer program that turns scattered feedback into structured, trusted input for every product team; a bug management process that gets defects triaged, prioritized, and resolved predictably; and the operating rhythm that keeps Engineering, Product, and Design aligned. You own the infrastructure and cadence; embedded Product Operations Managers own the interpretation and day\-to\-day judgment for their product areas.


**What You'll Do**
==================


### **Voice of the Customer Program**


* Design and stand up the end\-to\-end feedback pipeline: intake from CS, Support, Sales, and EAPs into one structured system
* Partner with RevOps to design \& implement tooling; define the workflows that make submitting feedback the easy default for field teams
* Set the weekly triage cadence and SLAs so every piece of signal is classified, routed, and visible
* Build reporting that Product, GTM, and leadership actually read — volume, themes, trends, and what changed
* Own the classification model: product area, matter stage, root cause (missing capability, defect, or usability friction)
* Give Design and Research standing views into the signal that matters to them

### **Product Operating Rhythm**


* Design and run the core engineering, product \& design rituals: planning cycles, roadmap reviews, design reviews, and monthly business reviews
* Build the run\-of\-business systems that scale as Harvey grows — intake frameworks, RACI structures, decision logs, shared calendars
* Facilitate roadmap planning by coordinating inputs across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM and maintaining transparency across the org
* Make it clear across Harvey what EPD is building, how it's progressing, and what's coming next
* Own the end\-to\-end bug lifecycle: intake from Support and the field, severity definitions, triage, routing to engineering teams, and resolution tracking
* Define severity and SLA standards that CS, Support, and Engineering all agree to and can see
* Run the recurring bug review with engineering and product leads; escalate aging or customer\-impacting defects
* Report bug volume, aging, and resolution trends by product area, and connect defect signal back into the Voice of the Customer taxonomy
* Close the loop with Support and CS so customers hear when their issue is fixed

**What You Have**
=================


* 5\+ years in program management, product operations, or a related operational role at a high\-growth tech or SaaS company
* You've built processes and programs from scratch and scaled them — not just inherited and maintained them
* Hands\-on experience running bug triage or incident/defect management processes across Engineering and Support
* Experience designing and facilitating product development rituals — planning, reviews, prioritization — with senior engineering and design leaders
* Deep fluency with feedback, ticketing, and data tooling; you're comfortable owning a taxonomy and the systems that enforce it
* Ability to translate messy qualitative and quantitative input into clear, structured outputs
* Proven ability to drive alignment and adoption across CS, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering without direct authority
* Experience with AI\-native or highly technical products is a plus
* You create clarity where none exists, and you're energized by a blank slate

**Compensation**
================


$155,400 \- $233,200 USD

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


The Future Forward organization is Intuitive’s advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next\-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic\-assisted surgery.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


The Program is responsible for leading and executing the full product development lifecycle of medical device capital systems, from initial concept through commercial launch. This role requires deep expertise in medical device development, regulatory pathways, operations, and cross\-functional project management. The Program Manager serves as a key driver of product innovation, compliance, and operational excellence within the organization. The Program Manager provides strategic leadership and tactical execution across all stages of product development, including concept generation, design, prototyping, verification and validation, regulatory submissions, manufacturing transfer, and launch. The role is pivotal in ensuring that all products meet stringent compliance requirements, including FDA, EU MDR, ISO standards, and relevant quality system regulations.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


Strategic Leadership


* Partner with product, technical, and functional leaders to shape program strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution plans.
