* Facilitate program reviews and structured decisions to resolve issues, balance trade\-offs, and maintain momentum.
* Lead cross\-functional negotiations, resolve root\-cause disputes, and build sustainable stakeholder alignment.
* Create concise executive narratives and reports that integrate analysis, recommendations, risks, and trade\-offs.

Product \& Design Development


* Lead cross\-functional teams through concept development, design iteration, prototyping, verification/validation, and design transfer to manufacturing.
* Resolve cross\-functional dependencies across subsystem teams, external partners, manufacturing, regulatory, and commercial functions.
* Partner with design, clinical, human factors, and engineering teams to ensure product requirements, usability, and performance criteria are met.
* Lead design control and business reviews, ensuring governance, compliance, accountability, and timely escalation.

Operational Execution


* Drive manufacturing readiness, including process development, supply chain coordination, build readiness, and launch planning.
* Ensure smooth transition from R\&D to operations with strong cross\-functional integration and documentation rigor.
* Support ongoing product lifecycle, cost reductions, reliability improvements, and sustainment workstreams.
* Partner with Finance to monitor program budgets, resource allocation, and long\-term financial impacts.
* Manage scope across projects, evaluating strategic alignment, delivery impact, dependencies, and trade\-offs.
* Optimize WBS and program schedules across interdependent projects, including critical and near\-critical path analysis.

Regulatory \& Compliance


* Ensure project deliverables meet relevant US and global medical device standards and quality system requirements.
* Coordinate cross\-functional preparation of regulatory documentation and testing.
* Champion strong design controls, risk management, and audit\-ready documentation throughout the lifecycle.
* Anticipate systemic regulatory, financial, operational, and technical risks; drive cross\-functional response plans.

### **Qualifications**


**Skills, Experience, Education, \& Training:**


Required:


* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Biomedical Engineering or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
* At least a minimum of 10 years' experience leading complex medical device development programs, including capital equipment or system\-level products, from concept through commercial launch.
* In\-depth knowledge of medical device regulatory pathways (FDA, EU MDR, ISO 13485\), submission requirements, and quality system regulations.
* Proven ability to lead and influence cross\-functional teams at multiple levels of the organization.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, operations, regulatory, quality, and clinical teams throughout all development phases.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to handle ambiguity effectively and oversee multiple large projects at once
* Advanced program planning skills, including WBS, dependency management, critical path analysis, scope control, risk management, and governance reporting.
* Ability to coach peers on stakeholder engagement, communication, scheduling discipline, and program management tools.
* Experience evaluating trade\-offs across product features, customer needs, manufacturability, and cost.

jobs.title: Program Leader, GenAI & Voice AI Innovation
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

  

The Program Leader, GenAI \& Voice AI Innovation sits within the Global Digital Experience (GDX) team \- the digital service design arm of the global CommOps organization. This role owns the end\-to\-end operationalization of transformational GenAI and Voice AI programs: scoping products for high business impact, running vendor pilots, designing evaluation frameworks, removing implementation roadblocks, and building the phased playbooks that take a program from a handful of pilot calls to a multi\-market, multi\-language rollout.
  

  

This is a builder's role. You'll typically run more than one program at a different stage of maturity at the same time \- a live vendor pilot needing daily quality monitoring, an expansion strategy needing market\-by\-market sequencing, and a cross\-functional standing forum needing weekly alignment \- and you'll be the person who can hold all three without dropping a thread.
  

  

The successful candidate combines strong technical and business acumen with the operational rigor to build repeatable frameworks (SOPs, evaluation rubrics, scale\-up gates) out of a first\-of\-its\-kind pilot, and the stakeholder management skill to bring Tech, Product, Ops, and external vendors along at the same time.
  

  

**What You'll Do**  

  

**Program \& vendor management**
* Own end\-to\-end program management for GenAI/Voice AI pilots \- from vendor selection and evaluation through phased global expansion \- managing multiple programs at different stages simultaneously.
* Design and run structured vendor evaluation frameworks (manual call/transcript review \+ quantitative metrics) to select, compare, and manage competing GenAI vendors running parallel pilots on separate traffic splits.
* Own the day\-to\-day pilot operations during launch windows, including hands\-on quality monitoring (e.g., reviewing live call/session volume) as a deliberate checkpoint before scaling traffic.
* Lead knowledge/API handoff and onboarding packages for external vendor partnerships.

**Product scoping \& policy design**
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering to translate existing operational policy (e.g., rigid if/then decision trees) into conversational, agentic flows with guardrails suitable for GenAI/LLM\-driven automation.
* Curate golden datasets with Product and Ops partners \- hand\-picking representative and edge\-case scenarios \- to ground evaluation and model tuning.
* Identify the right business problems and use cases to apply GenAI/Voice AI and quantify potential impact (e.g., cost savings, resolution rate, handle time, CSAT) to prioritize the roadmap.

**Evaluation frameworks \& quality governance**
* Author and maintain evaluation SOPs that define the standard for quality measurement across automated (on\-platform) and manual (offline human judgment) evaluation tracks, including critical vs. non\-critical error taxonomies.
* Run recurring QA review and calibration cadences; consolidate insights and KPIs into recommendations for Engineering and Product.
* Define and enforce phased scale\-up gates (data review, manual evaluation sign\-off, leadership sign\-off) before expanding a program's scope, market, or traffic allocation.

**Scaling \& cross\-functional leadership**
* Author multi\-phase expansion strategies spanning markets, languages, and policy types, including market/policy selection criteria, rollout sequencing, and pre\-launch requirements (legal/compliance, technical validation, evaluator readiness).
* Bring insights and feedback, socialize impact broadly, and hand over mature programs to BAU (Business As Usual) teams once scaled.
* Serve as the GDX point of contact / escalation owner for adjacent platform topics that intersect with your programs (e.g., AI safety/guardrail enablement decisions), clarifying ownership boundaries with partner platform teams.
* Represent your program portfolio in operating reviews, quarterly planning intake, and cross\-functional standing forums (tech program syncs, weekly business/vendor syncs, quarterly alignment forums).
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with Tech and Ops stakeholders to communicate program status, educate on new capabilities, and evangelize adoption of transformative technology.

**Basic Qualifications*** Minimum 5 years of experience in Product Management, Program Management, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or MBA.
8\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, or a similar role, including direct ownership of vendor pilots or 0* 1 programs.
* Hands\-on experience designing evaluation frameworks/rubrics and quality SOPs for AI or automation programs (golden datasets, calibration sessions, critical\-error taxonomies).
* Experience with conversational AI / Voice AI / LLM\-agent products, including translating operational policy into agentic flows with guardrails.
* Experience managing global, multi\-market, multi\-language program rollouts with phased gating criteria.
* Familiarity with AI safety, guardrail, or trust \& safety considerations in production AI systems, and comfort acting as a cross\-team escalation point on ambiguous ownership questions.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and program management skills; ability to adapt to failed experiments and pivot quickly to new initiatives.
* Strong track record at a top\-tier strategy consulting or tech firm delivering implementation projects.
* Ability to read technical documentation (PRDs, architecture diagrams) and translate it for operational and business stakeholders.
* Exceptionally strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to push back constructively.
* Data\-driven mindset \- comfortable defining and reporting on metrics like resolution rate, CSAT, average handle time, and cost savings to justify scale decisions.
Obsession for delivering a great customer experience; strategic/visionary thinker.

jobs.title: Physical Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Pivot Point Solutions**
=========================



Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based consulting firm that delivers experienced field professionals to construction and utility organizations across the state. We partner with contractors, program owners, and utility clients to provide skilled inspection, construction management, and field support personnel who keep infrastructure projects safe, compliant, and on schedule.



Our team understands the demands of active construction environments, from underground gas and electric infrastructure to large\-scale utility programs. By pairing deep industry knowledge with a responsive, hands\-on approach, we help clients maintain quality, meet regulatory requirements, and keep field operations running smoothly on some of California's most critical infrastructure projects.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Title:** Physical Security Project Manager  

**Sector:** Physical Security / Construction  

**Seniority:** Senior Level  

**Primary Locations:** Santa Cruz or Santa Clara, CA  

**Travel:** Occasional travel to Monterey and San Bernardino, CA  

**Job Type:** Hybrid – Office, Field \& Home  

**Contract Length:** 1 Year \+  

**Compensation:** $58\.00 \- $80\.00/hour


**Role Overview**
-----------------



Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced Physical Security Project Manager to lead the planning and field execution of complex physical security and low\-voltage system projects throughout California. This role will oversee projects involving access control, video surveillance/CCTV, intrusion detection, perimeter protection, intercoms, and supporting electrical and low\-voltage infrastructure.



The ideal candidate brings at least seven years of relevant project management experience and a strong field construction background. This position requires someone who can move comfortably between project planning and active job sites, coordinate contractors and technical teams, evaluate installation conditions, manage budgets and schedules, and oversee testing and commissioning while maintaining disciplined project documentation and governance.


**Your Day\-to\-Day Activities**
--------------------------------


* Manage physical security and low\-voltage projects from planning and site assessment through installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource requirements, milestones, and project documentation.
* Conduct job walks and site assessments to validate design requirements, installation conditions, constructability, and project risks.
* Coordinate installation of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarms, intercoms, perimeter security, and supporting infrastructure.
* Manage security integrators, subcontractors, technicians, vendors, and other project resources.
* Coordinate physical security activities with IT, Corporate Security, facilities, construction teams, and business stakeholders.
* Review construction drawings, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, and installation requirements.
* Coordinate procurement of equipment, materials, permits, and other resources necessary for project execution.
* Monitor field activities for safety, workmanship, quality, schedule adherence, and compliance with project requirements.
* Troubleshoot technical and construction issues and coordinate solutions with installation teams and stakeholders.
* Oversee inspection, functional testing, commissioning, and turnover of installed security systems.
* Maintain accurate project records, including risk and issue logs, change documentation, as\-built information, progress reports, and closeout packages.
* Track project budgets, labor hours, material costs, forecasts, and overall financial performance.
* Identify scope changes and coordinate appropriate change management and change order documentation.
* Provide structured project status reporting to project sponsors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Proactively identify project risks, dependencies, and field constraints and drive mitigation plans through resolution.
* Coordinate final project handoff to operations and support teams.

**The Job Requirements**
------------------------


* 7\+ years of relevant experience managing physical security, low\-voltage, electrical, or closely related field construction projects.
* Direct experience managing field installation projects involving physical security systems.

**Entry**
Must be able to achieve many objectives of this position. Requires some amount of timely supervision to ensure the proper tasks are being accomplished and that communication is adequate, timely, in the correct manner (i.e., verbal, written, email, etc.)  

**Experience**
Consistently achieves all the objectives of this position. This individual also provides mentoring and direct day\-to\-day supervision to level 1 positions.

Highly experienced in the position. This individual has a deep understanding of the many systems installed and maintained within the division. May act as a lead to assist others on very complex project tasks. Also provides mentoring and direct supervision when required on projects.

====================================


* Provides input to sales and operations regarding the technical and business considerations for construction or direct owner projects. This input could be associated with areas such as estimating, value engineering, timing, special resource needs, or other aspects peculiar to specific projects.

* Recommends technical solutions to sales and operations. Assist Sales team during estimating phase.
* Identifies change order opportunities and coordinates with sales to document, pursue, and book them.
* Provide support to Next Level and other contractors to solve building operating issues that go beyond the controls or special systems operation.
* Communicate with internal employees as required to ensure Next Level labor is accurate and timely and estimated productivity is achieved in all areas.

* Communicate with external organizations as required such as consulting engineers, building owners, and other contractors to ensure accurate and timely engineering.

* Experience and expertise including but not limited to:
* An understanding of basic computer operating systems.
* Some experience with BAS programming.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:** Gexpro Services is a world\-class Supply Chain Services outsource provider, specializing in developing and managing production inventory management programs. Our managed inventory programs are designed to support manufacturing OEM’s with their engineered production material specifications, fulfillment, and quality requirements.

**Program Manager Benefits:** Gexpro Services offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Competitive compensation plus annual bonus
* Flexible work schedule
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurance and pet insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee assistance program and Health wellness programs
* 401(k) immediately with a competitive match.
* Several paid holidays and paid time off that includes personal, sick and vacation time.

**Program Manager Description:** The ideal Program Manager role will preferably possess a bachelor’s degree and/or have a combination of supply chain knowledge and relevant experience in a customer\-facing role. A qualified candidate should possess the ability to lead customer business review presentations on a variety of topics which may include but not limited to, on time delivery, sales trends, obsolesces inventory, cost saving initiatives, fulfillment solution projects, scope expansion and any other projects. It addition, the Program manager must be able to perform the following tasks:

  

* Develop a strategic and targeted customer service approach to attain and exceed annual sales quota and commercial margin rate of assigned customer account worth at least $1M in annual sales.
* Cultivate and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with assigned customers by understanding needs, objectives, and pain points to manage their supply chain.
* Manage discrete, ILM, VMI and/or consignment inventory program(s), assessing the risks and opportunities, while consistently improving the fulfillment process.
* Provides customer account management which may include, but is not limited to tactical supports such, order entry, order inquiry, product information, order status, pricing, inventory inquiries, customer fulfillment and transportation management to analyze and resolve customer needs.
* Provides strategic account management which include more complex support such as forecasting, monitoring negative transactions, overall profitability and completing all contractual obligations.
* Working independently and/or with cross\-functional team members to resolve complex escalations from customer such as resolve shortages, possible line down, quality issues.
	+ Such as the NCNR and/RAM process
* Guarantee parts are ordered timely to insure on\-time delivery.
* Drive process improvements within assigned customer base.
* Resolve escalated/complex customer inquiries concerning shipment problems, order changes, invoice variations, etc., using root\-cause analysis.
* May attend/lead quarterly business review with internal team members or external customer and suppliers to provide performance and inventory updates to assigned customer base.
* Ensure prompt payment on invoicing for assigned customer base.
* Own execution of deflationary effort for assigned customer base, if needed.
* Review customer forecast and usage through data analysis to show current trends and predict future trends to prepare correct stocking levels with consideration to lead times.
* Provide technical and product knowledge support to supplier and customer base as needed to ensure account is properly maintained.
* In some cases, the Program Manager may have management responsibilities of a small team of Warehouse Leaders, Inside Sales Representatives and/or Project Managers \- Sales.
* Other duties as assigned by Senior Program Manager, Service Site Manager and/or Service Center Manager.

 **Program Manager Requirements:** The Program Manager should preferably possess a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in a customer\-facing role within the supply chain industry OR an equivalent combination of education and experience within the supply chain industry in program management/sales/service capacities owning program strategy and end to end delivery. The ideal candidate should posses the ability to define and execute against program requirements. The Program Manager should possess a combination of proven product and application knowledge, negotiation skills, interpersonal skills, effective communication skills, organization skills, and problem\-solving skills to drive decisions with influence presenting to senior executive.

 **DISCLAIMER:**The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager, Air (EHR)
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**


As Senior Implementation Manager, Air (EHR), you will own the end\-to\-end implementation of onboarding and launching new customers on Athelas Air (EHR). You’ll partner with Engineering and Launch to ensure each practice transitions smoothly, on time, and with high adoption. You’ll build scalable launch playbooks; scope, define, and prioritize product features based on customer workflows; define success metrics; and continuously refine processes to accelerate time\-to\-value.


Read more about Air!

 **This full\-time position requires working 5 days a week in our Mountain View, CA office.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Customer Discovery, Workflow Analysis \& Technical Collaboration:**


	+ Engage directly with customers to map their existing clinical and administrative workflows.
* **Product Management \& Technical Specifications:**


	+ Draft detailed functional and technical specifications (user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, interface requirements) based on scoped customer needs.
	+ Partner with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility, clarify requirements, and prioritize specs in the development backlog.
* **Project Leadership \& Stakeholder Coordination:**


	+ Develop and maintain detailed implementation plans, timelines, and resource allocations for each customer launch.
	+ Lead cross\-functional launch teams through weekly status calls, playbook adherence, and risk\-mitigation workflows.
	+ Act as the primary operations liaison among Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Support.
	+ Align on deliverables, dependencies, and hand\-offs; flag and escalate critical\-path issues early.
* **Process Design, Optimization \& Tooling:**


	+ Create and evolve scalable, standardized launch playbooks and templates for data migration, build\-out, training, and go\-live support.
	+ Identify bottlenecks and implement continuous improvements to reduce time\-to\-launch and increase launch quality.
	+ Build and maintain internal Retool applications to streamline operational workflows and empower non\-technical stakeholders to create custom dashboards, reports, and tools without code.
* **Go\-Live Support \& Adoption:**


	+ Facilitate hypercare support during and immediately after go\-live; track issue\-resolution SLAs.
	+ Monitor and report on key adoption metrics (e.g., login rates, documentation volume, billing task completion).

**What You Have**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree a plus.
* **Experience:**


	+ **5\+ years** of operations or project management experience in SaaS or HealthTech.
	+ Proven track record of leading complex, cross\-functional programs to successful delivery on time and within scope.


Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

  

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.


Compensation Range: $120K \- $160K

The IT Systems \& Project Coordinator I supports IT leadership and operations by managing administrative workflows, coordinating projects, maintaining departmental organization, and ensuring efficient execution of IT processes. This role serves as a central point of coordination across IT functions, supporting project execution, vendor management, inventory and procurement, compliance responsibilities, and internal communications.  


The Native American Health Center is an accredited institution and adheres to the standards of excellence set forth by the Accreditation Association of Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC) and the Commission of Dental Accreditation (CODA).  


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: IT Operations \& Administrative Coordination:  
1\. Manage and monitor IT intake channels (e.g., ticketing system, shared inbox, phone line), ensuring timely routing, tracking and resolution of requests.  
2\. Maintain IT calendars, schedules and coordinate department meetings.  
3\. Prepare meeting agendas, document meeting minutes, track action items.  
4\. Serve as a central point of coordination for internal and external IT\-related communications.  
5\. Maintain organized electronic and physical records for IT operations, projects, and documentation.  
6\. Provide administrative support to IT leadership, including coordination and tracking of staff timesheets, scheduling, and related administrative processes as needed.

8\. Track project timelines, deliverables, and action items to ensure project progress and completion.  
9\. Coordinate with IT team members and other departments to ensure alignment and follow\-through.  
10\. Assist with gathering, organizing, and summarizing data for project planning and reporting.  


Procurement \& Inventory Management  
11\. Oversee IT inventory management, including tracking, auditing and maintaining accurate records of equipment and supplies.  
12\. Coordinate procurement of IT equipment and supplies, including vendor sourcing, price comparisons, and order tracking.  
13\. Ensure timely processing of purchases and delivery of equipment to appropriate locations.  
14\. Support lifecycle management of IT assets, including intake, tracking and decommissioning.

20\. Serve as a key coordinator for IT\-related audits, security assessments, and accreditation processes.  
21\. Support documentation requests and data gathering for compliance and regulatory reviews.  
22\. Support documentation and tracking security\-related programs (e.g., Managed Phishing Testing \& Training Program, cybersecurity initiatives, employee trainings).

27\. Respond to inquiries and provide information related to IT operations when appropriate.  
28\. Support cross\-functional initiatives and special projects assigned.  
29\. Work well under pressure, meet multiple and often competing deadlines, and demonstrate cooperative behavior with supervisors, subordinates, colleagues, clients and the community.

31\. Maintain compliance with ergonomic safety standards; be mindful of posture and regularly practice ergonomic stretches.

3\. Strong communication and coordination skills.  
4\. Experience coordinating and providing support for large complex projects.  
5\. Strong organizational and time management skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Project Manager - Active Clearance Required
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have multiple openings for **Project Managers** to lead project\-management activities and support the planning and successful execution of high\-impact technical projects addressing critical national security challenges. You will serve as a key project\-management resource for milestone\-driven research and development efforts in a fast\-paced, multidisciplinary environment. Working closely with Associate Program Leaders, Principal Investigators, technical staff, and other project stakeholders, you will help organize project teams and coordinate schedules, budgets, milestones, risks, resources, agreements, reporting, and technical communications to enable successful project execution on aggressive timelines.


You will contribute to a growing portfolio of national security research and development initiatives in areas such as cyber\-physical systems assurance, national security infrastructure, supply chain security, and disaster resilience. This position provides an opportunity to apply project\-management, technical, and operational expertise to first\-of\-a\-kind national security work while helping technical teams effectively organize, plan, coordinate, and execute complex activities. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division within the Engineering Directorate.


*Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid work arrangement, blending in\-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.*


These positions will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.


**In this role, you will**


* Lead day\-to\-day project\-management activities for milestone\-driven technical projects across cyber and infrastructure domains, including schedules, deliverables, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, and project documentation.
* Advise and support Associate Program Leaders and Principal Investigators in project team organization, resource coordination, budget tracking, scheduling, milestone planning, risk mitigation, and progress toward technical and programmatic objectives.
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize scientific and technical information for project reports, proposals, milestone deliverables, sponsor communications, and decision briefings.
* Coordinate technical and operational communications among project teams, collaborators, management, sponsors, and other stakeholders to support timely and effective project execution.
* Identify and recommend improvements to established project\-management and operational principles, methods, and tools to improve project execution, workflow, documentation, team coordination, and organizational processes.
* Coordinate documentation, schedules, deliverables, funding information, and other activities associated with contracts, subcontract\-related efforts, collaboration agreements, and external project partnerships.
* Implement, maintain, and contribute to the improvement of project\-management frameworks, tools, processes, and practices used to monitor budgets, schedules, resources, risks, milestones, and project performance.
* Organize and facilitate project and team meetings, including schedules, logistics, agendas, presentation materials, decisions, action items, and follow\-up activities.
* Coordinate with staff and project\-management personnel at other national laboratories and partner organizations to support communication, planning, team organization, resource coordination, milestones, and execution of multi\-laboratory projects and consortia.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the TSS.3 level**

* Conduct complex technical and operational project\-coordination activities under minimal direction, developing approaches, priorities, and solutions necessary to support successful completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* Perform independent technical and operational analyses, synthesize project information, and develop recommendations to inform strategic project decisions involving schedules, budgets, resources, risks, priorities, and execution approaches.
* Analyze and resolve complex project execution issues requiring in\-depth analysis, ingenuity, and creative application of established project\-management, technical, and operational methods.
* Coordinate and prioritize multiple parallel activities involving competing requirements, changing priorities, or less well\-defined assignments, and provide project leadership for defined activities by coordinating contributors and guiding execution toward project objectives.

### **Qualifications**


* This position requires an active DOE Q\-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, project management, business, engineering, or a related technical field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
* Comprehensive knowledge of project\-management concepts, practices, and tools, with broad experience applying project\-management principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to technical or operational projects.
* Comprehensive experience independent

Sitting at the intersection of operations and advanced technology, you'll serve as the technical liaison between our operational workflows and the data science and engineering teams building the models, tools, and agentic systems that scale this work far beyond what manual review can achieve alone. You'll partner with engineering to develop agents, help establish the key infrastructure to support and integrate them, and define how humans stay in the loop as that infrastructure matures. You'll translate messy operational reality \- everything from track\-level metadata quirks to editorial judgment calls \- into crisp technical requirements, evaluate the solutions that come back, and decide what ships.

Help establish the key infrastructure to support, integrate, and orchestrate agents over time \- shaping how agentic systems plug into existing curation workflows and data. Define the future operating model for curation \- determining where agents handle work autonomously and where humans stay in the loop for high\-priority, high\-risk, or quality\-assessment cases, including review of agent output. Translate operational challenges into clear, actionable specifications that engineering and data science teams can execute against. Break down ambiguous problems into well\-scoped, prioritized workstreams, sequenced by impact. Start with the highest\-leverage slice; iterate from there. Design and iterate on human\-in\-the\-loop tooling that surfaces agent and model outputs (confidence scores, candidate matches, suggested labels, risk signals) so reviewers can validate high\-stakes decisions with speed and accuracy. Run ROI and impact analyses to distinguish short\-term tactical wins from long\-term structural solutions, and to prioritize where automation delivers the most leverage. Communicate upward \- build clear, compelling narratives and decks, and present progress, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership. Partner cross\-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Product, Editorial, Analytics, and peer Operations teams (including Artist Curation, Shazam Operations, Partner Operations, and Data Strategy) to surface interdependencies and align priorities.","responsibilities":"The right person for this role is a rare combination of technically fluent and deeply detail\-oriented \- someone who thinks in systems, moves with urgency, and knows how to get things done across complex, cross\-functional environments.

**About Glide**
GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. Reporting to the Talent Manager, the HR Coordinator will be fully immersed in all areas of our hiring, recruitment and our onboarding processes. You will be responsible for administrative and logistical support for HR, but you will also be a key anchor for the recruitment team. Specifically, you will ensure the on and offboarding processes run smoothly, you will initiate the recruitment and posting of our positions and you will help coordinating our staff events. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for all new hires, and ensure each new hire has completed all required documentation and has the appropriate office set up.

Key Qualities needed for this role:
* You’re a proactive problem\-solver who keeps things moving behind the scenes with minimal direction.
* You’re organized, detail\-oriented, and thrive in a fast paced organization.
* You can multiple tasks/projects, meet deadlines, and enjoy working as a team.

### **Primary Responsibilities**


* This position will work collaborate across the hiring and training teams to ensure HR supports everything from pre\-boarding to offboarding, initiating and following up on operational Zendesk tickets, tracking recruitment processes.
* Will support the Talent Manager with all activity tied to recruitment. Specifically, ensuring our jobs are posted in the ATS, work with hiring managers to schedule candidate interviews, and with an eye on details, continually update our job postings across different sites to promote and/or accelerate candidate flow.
* Be able to distribute internal job postings to staff, refresh job boards and update recruitment tracking sheet to ensure updates are recorded in a timely fashion.

* Schedules and facilitates onboarding in collaboration with the hiring managers and staff training and development team.

* Be able to follow up with new hires on background and reference checks; and assist new employees with new hire documents, to ensure they are completed in a timely fashion.
* Using Zendesk, ensure the timely execution of new hire onboarding/offboarding processes. This includes termination notifications, new hire paperwork collection and uploads into ADP, I\-9 and completion of the background check process.
* Provide culturally relevant and responsive support to all employees while maintaining confidentiality and compliance with internal policies and procedures
* Will perform other duties as required.

* Proven customer service skills and enthusiasm for providing exceptional service to a diverse population of candidates and staff.

* Finger dexterity and the ability to use all standard office equipment.

This is a fulltime (40 hour/week), non\-exempt role.**Work Environment**
GLIDE’s buildings are located in the Tenderloin neighborhood. GLIDE maintains an "open door" policy to the community and its clients, who frequently enter and leave the building.

jobs.title: Product Ops Manager, Facebook Social & Meta AI
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Product Operations Manager to join Facebook Product Operations and drive product quality, AI\-powered automation, and operational excellence across FB's surfaces, specifically Social's hypergrowth app releases. We are in the middle of a transformation, becoming an AI\-driven, individual\-contributor\-led organization that scales through orchestration, deep product expertise, and technical excellence. Our team is building and operating autonomous agents that handle end\-to\-end workflows (triage, bug resolution, launches, dogfooding, evals) with minimal human intervention.If you're energized by owning complex quality programs end\-to\-end, building and operating AI\-driven workflows, and driving measurable product improvements in a fast\-paced environment, this role is for you.You will be responsible for investigating and communicating the quality of FB's products to engineering, product, design, and other cross\-functional partners. You will own AI builds for collecting, generating, and triaging reported quality issues. Additionally, you will partner with product and engineering teams to implement process and tooling improvements focused on driving developer efficiency, resolution of issues, and improved product quality.  

  

  

### **Product Ops Manager, Facebook Social \& Meta AI Responsibilities:**

* Become an expert in the health and quality of Facebook's Social and AI products, identifying trends, regressions, and user pain points through data analysis and hands\-on product usage
* Own end\-to\-end product quality programs for your area, including launches, dogfooding, root cause analyses, incident reviews, and app health regressions automating first and operating with high reliability
* Design, build, and operate autonomous AI agents and workflows for your product area: bug triage, prioritization, classification, deduplication, and resolution
* Partner with engineering and product teams to drive resolution of high\-priority issues and influence product roadmap based on quality insights
* Prepare communication materials and progress tracking for multiple audiences including delivering updates to leadership stakeholders
* Collect, analyze, and leverage data to identify quality trends and inform product decisions
* build dashboards and metrics to drive data\-driven decision making
* Build and maintain an evaluation (evals) practice for your area, ensuring AI solutions meet accuracy thresholds through LLM judges, labellers, and governance frameworks
* Assess and improve existing AI solutions within your scope, driving migration to standard platforms and partnering with AI Implementations leadership on scaling decisions
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams and Foundations partners to align on org\-wide priorities and share best practices
* Design and operate AI workflows that comply with Facebook data sensitivity guardrails, ensuring quality signals are collected and processed within encryption boundaries and privacy\-first constraints

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of related strategy, operations, consulting, or data analyst experience
* Analytical experience using data to tell a story and influence product direction using intermediate to advanced SQL
* Experience building or deploying AI/ML solutions or automation in production workflows
* Strong communication skills with ability to influence multiple cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership
* Experience breaking down ambiguous issues into component parts to develop and implement solutions
* Experience with AI products / platforms, with understanding of mobile\-first product behaviors, encryption, and multi\-platform feature parity

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience working on or with Facebook or comparable large\-scale messaging products
* Experience in product quality, QA, or technical program management
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or ML evaluation frameworks
* Experience operating effectively in organizations with minimal hierarchy, taking ownership of workstreams with high individual autonomy
* Experience working with global/remote teams

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Materials Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in a network of electric air taxis. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push onward toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service.
**Overview**
------------



In this role you’ll own the creation and oversight of left\-to\-right clear to build schedules to support builds. As an MPM, you will oversee manufacturing operations (production, quality, material planning) cost, schedule and deliverables during New Product Introduction (NPI), Ramp and Sustaining Phases as well as organize and oversee manufacturing (in house or Contract Manufacturer) transition from validation to ramp and production states.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Create and deploy supply requirements to the supply base via MRP which achieves production, inventory and cost objectives. Ensure demand from all sources (production, aftermarket, engineering, etc.) is supported appropriately
* Manage safety stock levels and optimize logistical efficiency by managing EOQs
* Manage planning system parameters and master data to optimally reflect supply chain capabilities and plan supply. Deliver clear\-to\-build status, material coverage, run\-out reports and other analyses as needed to plan production and business targets. Provide data\-driven decision support to the broader organization through what\-if and scenario planning (as examples)
* Work with external suppliers to establish the appropriate delivery schedules for individual components, specifying quantity and frequency targeting on\-time delivery; coordinate with Supply Chain team and Logistics as needed
* Collaborate with Supply Chain and Engineering to support material changes resulting from Change action (CAs), plan for new material and minimize obsolescence of old material
* Apply analytics and supply chain expertise to manage system parameters and meet target inventory and service level goals while minimizing costs and obsolescence
* Build and maintain operational partnerships with assigned suppliers. Act as the primary interface with suppliers on delivery status, issues and resolution
* Escalate to commercial or technical partners when required (procurement, accounts payable, quality, engineering, etc.)
* Support onboarding and training of new suppliers to ensure operational excellence and compliance with Joby’s supply chain processes and policies
* Coordinate supplier ramp up and down for new product launches, ensuring suppliers deliver shipments needed to support production targets
* Manage engineering changes to minimize obsolete inventory and ensure continuous supply
**Required**
------------


* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or other related field, or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years related experience in materials management, production planning, material scheduling, or purchasing in a manufacturing environment
* Proficiency in MS Excel, including ability to maintain and enhance Excel\-based material shortage reports
* Strong analytical capabilities
**Desired**
-----------


* Knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software, SAP enterprise system inventory management system such as SAP to Microsoft
**Additional Information**
--------------------------



Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $73,700 \- $125,400 per year. The compensation package will be determined by job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  

Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.  

Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

Standalone Account Managers are ambitious AM’s who can manage a more strategic sales cycle while being an advisor to customers that are consolidating more of their tech stack to Rippling.

--------------------

* Assist customers who are only using Rippling for specific product suites realize the full potential of the platform by consolidating more of their processes into Rippling.

widget: Full time
  
**About Four Seasons:**


Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**


A modern oasis in the city's most exciting location. At the epicentre of San Francisco stands the city’s iconic hotel, where business ideas emerge, loved ones connect and life’s most important celebrations happen. When you’re not shopping at Union Square, enjoying the city’s diverse culinary scene or exploring one of the Bay Area’s top attractions, unwind in our newly renovated guest rooms, designed to represent the natural beauty of San Francisco’s fog, redwood trees and ocean.
Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco overlooks Yerba Buena Gardens and is located just steps away from the City's Financial District, Union Square shopping, the Moscone Convention Center, the Museum of Modern Art, and the Contemporary Jewish Museum, amid the city's finest cultural and dining venues.

  

We are actively searching for an experienced and energetic manager to become Assistant Front Office Manager of Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco, supporting Front Office. This position may also provide occasional overnight relief.

This key management role is responsible for all managing the day\-to\-day operation of the Front Desk. You will direct staff and respond to a wide variety of guest requests, adding personal touches and recommendations with each interaction.

 **Essential Functions**  

*This list is not all –inclusive and should only be used as an overview of all actual responsibility.*

* Resolves customer complaints from all areas of the hotel, handling all guest interactions with the highest level of hospitality and professionalism, accommodating special requests whenever possible; assists customers in all inquiries in connection with hotel services, hours of operations, key hotel personnel, in\-house events, directions, etc. Responds to all guest requests in an accurate and timely manner. * Checks guest in and out in an efficient and friendly manner, using guest name whenever possible. Assures that guest is assigned type of room requested and the correct rate is charged. Ascertains guest satisfaction, collects keys, posts late charges and presents bill to guest. Settles bill accurately through credit card or cash transaction.
* Utilizes a variety of computer systems to check guests in and out, run daily reports and select and block rooms for arriving guests.
* Accepts reservations, changes and cancellations in the absence of Reservations Department Staff. Can answer guest calls and direct them appropriately in the absence of a Communications Operator.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Operations (Post-Sales)
jobs.description:
Monaco is building an AI\-native revenue platform that replaces the fragmented GTM stack \- CRM, sequencing, call recording, enrichment, pipeline management with one unified system, consolidating 6–10 disconnected tools into a single platform built for the AI era.


We launched publicly in Feb 2026, are already 65 people, and have strong early product\-market fit generating millions in ARR within months of launch. You'll have the chance to both scale our core systems and build new features from 0 to 1\.


We've raised $85M in our Series B from Founders Fund, Benchmark, and Human Capital, and our founders previously led Brex, Apollo, and Clari.


Come join us if you want to be part of a high autonomy, high pace team reinventing one of the biggest categories in enterprise software.

**The Role**
------------


You'll own post\-sales operations at Monaco and be the strategic partner to our launch operations and FDAE (post\-sales) teams. This is a senior RevOps hire with a post\-sales focus: you run the operational machinery that gets customers from signature to value, and you use data to tell leadership what's actually driving retention and expansion in a usage\-based business and how to implement it.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own GTM operations end to end for launch operations and post\-sales: onboarding, implementation, sales\-to\-post\-sales handoff, time\-to\-value, and the systems and processes the teams run on
* Find where customers stall in onboarding, fix the process, and measure the impact on activation and usage
* Identify what our top customers have in common and turn it into playbooks the whole team runs
* Grow usage\-based revenue with the post\-sales team: model consumption, spot expansion and at\-risk signals early, and build the motions that act on them
* Drive the post\-sales analytics with our data team: dig into activation, usage, customer health, expansion, churn, and FDAE productivity, and turn what you find into decisions
* Partner with launch, FDAE (post\-sales), and CX leaders on operational projects and drive them to completion
* Run leadership\-level reporting and planning on retention, expansion, and net revenue
* Be the person who spots the problem in the numbers before anyone else does, and brings a recommendation, not just a chart

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

**Must\-Haves**

* 2 \- 4 years at a top\-tier investment bank, management consulting, PE, or VC followed by 2\+ years in a GTM, RevOps, or BizOps role at an early\-stage startup
* Exceptional with data: fluent in SQL and spreadsheets, comfortable building models from scratch, and able to explain the answer to a sales leader in one sentence
* Strong instincts for what makes customers succeed, or the analytical horsepower to find it fast
* Thrive with autonomy in a high\-velocity environment where priorities shift weekly

**Strong Pluses**

* You've run post\-sales or CX operations before: onboarding, implementation, health scoring, and renewals
* Experience growing revenue in a usage\-based or hybrid pricing model
* Experience at a B2B early stage startup
* Track record of turning standout customer outcomes into a repeatable playbook

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**  

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987\. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site\-based programs and community outreach.

 **POSITION PURPOSE**  

LifeMoves \| Eleven Eleven provides interim supportive housing in San Carlos to 39 individual veterans. During their stay, clients participate in holistic services tailored to each household’s unique needs and goals. Clients receive support to build self\-sufficiency and return to housing stability. The team supports clients with employment, housing, benefits, physical and behavioral health through case management, workshops, and connection to specialized resources.  



The Eleven Eleven Veteran Case Manager plays a key role in supporting people moving toward safe, stable housing and greater self\-sufficiency. This position provide case management services, life skills support, and resource connections. They work in partnership with clients to set goals, celebrate progress, and overcome challenges. Using a trauma\-informed and strengths\-based approach, this position builds trust and respect, making sure clients feel heard, valued, and supported throughout their journey.


Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high\-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.  



The Veteran Case Manager (VA CM) reports to the site Program Director and specializes in working with veterans experiencing homelessness. This role understands the unique experiences and strengths veterans bring and helps connect them to the right services, including veteran\-specific housing, employment, and health care programs. They advocate for each veteran’s needs and build strong community partnerships to offer the best support possible. Additionally, this role supports daily program operations and helps keep the site safe and welcoming for everyone. This role works closely with clients and staff to build a positive  

community, and helps monitor the environment, responds to client needs, and ensures that all program rules are followed with fairness and respect. Finally, this role supports service delivery by helping with client check\- ins, group activities, and site coordination.

 **ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

 **Client Support and Case Management**

* Develop, implement, and revise individual case plans with housing/employment/benefit/health and well being tasks based on client strengths and goals.
* Support clients with tasks including but not limited to housing searches, employment preparation, benefits access, life skills development, build resumes, cover letters, and navigate employment and housing resources.
* Support clients with enrollment into benefit programs including but not limited to General Assistance, CalFresh, and Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants.
* Coordinate with health care access to understand and support client physical and behavioral health needs.

Assist clients by scheduling medical appointments, arranging transportation, and accompanying them to appointments as needed.  
* 

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community partners by building strong relationships, connecting clients to needed resources and services, and educating the community on client needs and trauma\-informed care.
* Coordinate with relevant public partners, for example probation officers, Veterans Affairs, Adult Protective Services (APS), Child Protective Services (CPS) and city, state, and federal agencies, to support client needs and program goals.
* Client Advocacy, Mediation, and Conflict Resolution
* Serve as a liaison between clients and landlords, employers, or agencies to support successful outcomes.
* Provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
* Advocate for client rights and reduce stigma around homelessness and mental health challenges.
* Advocate for clients' needs and strengths when working with partners, landlords, employers, and other agencies.

 **Data Tracking and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records, case notes, reports, and program data in line with agency standards and confidentiality laws utilizing Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) and the LifeMoves internal client management system
* Track client progress, program outcomes, housing placements, employment and learning successes, and community partnerships.

**Crisis Management and Safety**


Provide crisis intervention and make referrals to appropriate services when needed.  

* 

**General Agency Responsibilities**

* Participate in weekly case conferences, monthly trainings, and regular supervision to strengthen skills.
* Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying what you learn to your daily work.
* Training expectations in the first 90 days of employment include but are not limited to CPR, Mental Health/First Aide (MHFA), Nonviolent Crisis Intervention

**About ChipAgents**  

ChipAgents builds AI agents that help semiconductor engineers design and verify chips faster. We work with leading chip companies, cloud providers, and startups to improve the workflows behind RTL development, simulation, and verification.  

  

**Role Overview**  

We’re looking for an IT Operations Lead to own the technology our team relies on every day. You’ll manage our internal tools, employee devices, onboarding and offboarding, and office networks, making sure people have what they need to do their best work.  

Your job is to help the team move faster. We treat IT as an enabling function: remove friction, keep developers productive, and make everyday technology work reliably. Success means fast onboarding, quick resolution of issues, fewer interruptions, and tools that help people get their work done.  

You’ll be the primary point of contact for employee technology issues, taking ownership from the first report through resolution. You’ll also build the processes and automation that prevent recurring problems as the company grows.  

This is a hands\-on role with broad ownership and room to shape how IT operates at ChipAgents. You’ll bring practical judgment to security and reliability, choosing approaches proportionate to the risk and minimizing administrative overhead. Changes that materially affect development workflows or introduce new restrictions will be agreed with engineering leadership. You’ll also partner with engineering on internal infrastructure projects, with engineering retaining overall ownership of that infrastructure.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Internal Tools \& Access:** Administer our business applications, accounts, permissions, and software licenses. Make access straightforward, resolve configuration issues, and manage vendor support and renewals in partnership with relevant teams.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated to participate in a dynamic, multi\-tasking environment? Do you want to join a company that invests in its employees? Are you seeking a position where you can use your skills while continuing to be challenged and learn? Then we encourage you to dive deeper into this opportunity.


We believe in career development and empowering our employees. Not only do we provide career coaches internally, but we offer many training opportunities to expand your knowledge base! **NeoGenomics has an opening for a Senior Training Program Specialist, Commercial Education \& Effectiveness who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow. The ideal candidate will be located Remote Non\-CA with travel to Fort Myers for a week every other month.**

**Now that you know what we're looking for in talent, let us tell you why you'd want to work at NeoGenomics:**

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Senior Training Program Specialist owns the operational backbone of the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness (CEE) training calendar. The role plans and runs the logistics for approximately five new hire training classes per year, each built as a virtual week followed by a week\-long in\-person program, and partners with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session. The Specialist schedules and confirms presenters, manages hotel and program logistics, prepares materials, administers the learning platform and the CEE SharePoint site, and maintains attendance, completion, and evaluation records.


This is a program and project management role. The Specialist is the single point of accountability for ensuring programs run on time, on budget, and without disruption to learning.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end logistics plan and timeline for approximately five new hire training classes per year, working backward from each class start date across both the virtual and in\-person portions of the program.
* Schedule and confirm presenters for virtual training sessions, including invitations, calendar management, content collection, quality review, and same\-day support.
* Manage hotel, venue, and participant travel logistics for week\-long in\-person programs, including room blocks, meeting space, audiovisual requirements, food and beverage coordination, and accessibility needs.
* Partner with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session, owning the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness training workstream.
* Serve as the onsite point of contact during training programs, managing materials, shipping, badges, signage, room setup, and agenda changes.
* Track and reconcile program spend against budget, including vendor contracts, hotel invoices, purchase orders, and cost summaries.
* Build and maintain the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness SharePoint site, including document libraries, permissions, metadata, version control, and naming conventions.
* Audit and retire sales training content on a scheduled basis and coordinate required internal reviews for clinical, marketing, and claims\-related materials.
* Administer the learning platform, including curricula, enrollments, assignment rules, reporting, and learner record migration activities.
* Maintain accurate attendance, completion, assessment, and evaluation records and create post\-program reports.
* Utilize Microsoft Office and other digital tools to organize, track, and report training activities.
* Coordinate and facilitate communication within the commercial organization regarding training events, schedules, and updates.
* Support onboarding for new sales and support team members by ensuring system access and training resources are available before day one.
* Administer post\-training surveys and 60\- and 90\-day follow\-up assessments and summarize findings.
* Prepare manager touchpoint materials, including pre\-class briefing packets and post\-class coaching guides.
* Provide administrative support to the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness team and perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience, Education and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Five or more years of experience in program or project coordination, corporate meeting and event planning, training coordination, or a sales or support role.
* Experience in a diagnostic laboratory, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare environment preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a cross\-functional environment.
* Experience coordinating multi\-day, multi\-presenter meetings or training programs, including registrations, room blocks, banquet event orders, and vendor invoicing.
* Strong professional verbal and written communication skills and a customer\-focused approach.
* Demonstrated SharePoint proficiency, including document libraries, permissions, metadata management, and version control.
* Ability to effectively follow up with senior leaders and subject matter experts to secure commitments, presentations, and approvals on schedule.
* Learning management system administration experience preferred.

jobs.title: Continuing Education Program Coordinator

The Continuing Education Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the administration, development, growth, and promotion of the organization’s continuing education programs. This position combines program coordination with business development, instructor recruitment, course development support, customer service, and marketing.

A significant focus of this position will be helping grow the continuing education program by identifying and recruiting qualified physicians, psychologists, and other professionals to develop and present courses, assisting with the development and launch of new educational offerings, and increasing awareness and enrollment through social media and other promotional channels.

The Continuing Education Program Coordinator will work closely with the supervisor to ensure courses and programs are well organized, professionally presented, and administered in accordance with applicable continuing education requirements.

* Follow up with participants, instructors, and prospective instructors as needed.
* Monitor course registrations, completion requirements, evaluations, and other administrative components of continuing education programs.
* Assist with maintaining accurate course information, instructor information, schedules, and educational materials on the website.
* Identify administrative or participant issues and coordinate appropriate follow\-up and resolution.

* Assist with email campaigns and other outreach efforts designed to increase course enrollment.
* Monitor the effectiveness of promotional efforts and help identify strategies for increasing engagement and enrollment.

General Responsibilities

Qualifications

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest\-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world\-class talent. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. OpenAI builds powerful AI systems like ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and enterprise products that serve millions of users across the globe. As we scale, securing our infrastructure, protecting sensitive data, supporting employees’ velocity, and meeting global compliance standards are essential to our success and societal impact.


Security at OpenAI is a cross\-cutting organization that includes Security, Privacy, IT, GRC, Corporate Security, and other teams. Program Managers play a critical role in aligning teams and delivering execution at scale.

We’re seeking a Program Manager to build and own programs that span OpenAI’s Security organization, with a core focus on Mergers \& Acquisitions. You will work across domains from diligence through Day 1 readiness, integration, onboarding, and transition to ongoing ownership. You will also apply what you build to other priorities that span Security teams. You will learn how work actually moves between teams, spot gaps and unclear ownership, and build practical systems that make complex transitions easier to execute.


This role is deeply cross\-functional and execution\-focused. It requires a structured operator who thrives in ambiguityation and consequential decisions.


**In this role, you will:**


* Own Security \& IT M\&A programsing timely diligence assessments, and scoping, planning, and executing acquisition integrations. Carry the work through Day 1 readiness, onboarding of people and systems, post\-close priorities, and handoff to ongoing owners.
* Partner with Corporate Development, IT, Infrastructure, Application, Legal, Privacy, Security, GRC, Corporate Security and other teams to understand cross\-functional requirements and navigate tradeoffs. * Learn partner teams’ workflows and identify missed dependencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, and risks that could slow an integration or weaken its outcome. Address recurring problems at their source.
* Establish scalable frameworks and processes to support core programs, including defining durable program goals and core measures of success. Build useful intake paths, playbooks, onboarding checklists, decision points, and handoff standards that teams adopt in practice.
* Use AI and automation to organize informationation and human review of risk decisions.
* Create and maintain program\-level visibility across deals, risks, milestones, and dependencies, ensuring program outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality. Measure whether the work improves readiness, reduces manual effort, closes risks, and makes future transitions more predictable.

* Own additional programs that span Security and IT as organizational priorities evolve, applying and improving the systems built through the M\&A portfolio.
