new_jobs.description:
**Position Title:**
-------------------

Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant Project Manager
**Position Type:**
------------------

Regular
**Hiring Range:**
-----------------

$37\.31 \- $44\.79 per hour' *Compensation will be based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.*

**Pay Frequency:**
------------------

Hourly
A. POSITION PURPOSE


Under the supervision of the Sr. Assistant Dean / Chief Operating Officer and in close coordination with project co\-leads, the Project Manager provides administrative, operational, and tactical leadership for the implementation of the $10 Million Lilly Endowment Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant. This 5\-year grant project supports the launch and integration of the Pope Francis Institute for Pastoral Flourishing (PFI), the relocation and integration of JST\-SCU into Santa Clara University’s main campus, and the expansion of regional and national network partnerships.


The Project Manager serves as the primary operational engine driving daily grant activities. This position is responsible for ensuring all strategic deliverables, sub\-project timelines, inter\-departmental workflows, budget tracking, and official compliance reporting to the Lilly Endowment are executed seamlessly, accurately, and on schedule.


B. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


1\. Grant Project Management \& Operational Execution


* Serve as the central point of tactical execution, project tracking, and workflow management for all initiatives funded under the $10M Lilly LSC Grant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive master project plans, timelines, work breakdown structures, and milestone tracking frameworks across all grant components.
* Monitor day\-to\-day progress across project working groups, internal SCU departments (JST, GPPM, Religious Studies), and external collaborating partners.
* Manage the operational roadmap for Year 1 ("Year of Co\-Design"), coordinating inter\-departmental task forces, curriculum alignment teams, and committee deliverables.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, risks, or schedule deviations, implementing corrective action plans to maintain project momentum.

2\. Centralized Compliance, Financial Tracking \& Grant Reporting


* Manage overall compliance with Lilly Endowment Grant Agreement terms, conditions, and reporting requirements.
* Partner closely with SCU Office of Sponsored Projects (SPO), JST Finance, and University Development to monitor the $10M budget, track expenditure allocations, approve line\-item disbursements, and manage sub\-award contracts.
* Coordinate, write, and submit all annual narrative program reports and collaborate with the SPO to submit financial reports to the Lilly Endowment by established deadlines.
* Collect, aggregate, and verify project data, revenue match metrics, and qualitative/quantitative outcomes from constituent units (such as CLTM, PFI, and external partner networks) for centralized reporting.
* Oversee budget revision requests and line\-item reallocations in accordance with Lilly Endowment policy guidelines.

3\. Stakeholder Coordination \& Governance Support


* Facilitate regular communication, meeting schedules, documentation, and reporting streams for the Grant Steering Committee, Advisory Boards, and Working Groups.
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal academic units and external partner organizations (e.g., ACHTUS, RECOSS, Iskali, regional dioceses, Discerning Deacons), managing partner contracts, stipends, and joint project deliverables.
* Maintain central project repositories, shared documentation, communications archives, and collaborative platforms (e.g., Google Workspace/Drive) to ensure transparent governance.

4\. Communications, Dissemination \& Logistics


* Coordinate the execution of project events, national symposia, planning retreats, workshops, and advisory council meetings in collaboration with project staff.
* Implement the grant’s strategic communication and dissemination plan, sharing project insights, best practices, and research outputs with national theological networks and peer institutions.
* Maintain systematic evaluation data and performance indicators to measure long\-term institutional impact and pastoral reach.

5\. Other duties as assigned in support of JST’s mission and operational needs


C. PROVIDES WORK DIRECTION


May at times, directly supervise grant\-funded project personnel, logistics coordinators, and graduate student assistants. Provides cross\-functional project direction and milestone tracking for grant task force leads across partner departments.


D. GENERAL GUIDELINES


Establishes robust project tracking systems and monitors task completion across multiple independent workstreams.


Identifies operational risks early and formulates actionable recommendations for project leads and committee chairs.


Maintains continuous communication with internal SCU administrators, external partners, and grant officers.


Ensures strict adherence to institutional accounting policies, grant agreement terms, and federal/foundation compliance regulations.


Prepares comprehensive progress dashboards and status briefs for executive leadership.


E. QUALIFICATIONS


1\. Knowledge


* Thorough understanding of formal project management methodologies, lifecycle frameworks, and grant administration tools.
* Familiarity with private foundation grant administration (experience with Lilly Endowment grants or higher education sponsored programs highly preferred).
* Understanding of university organizational structures, academic administration, and multi\-institutional collaborative networks.
* Knowledge of Catholic ecclesiology, ministerial formation, and the pastoral realities in the United States preferred.
* Strong understanding of the values, ideals, and mission of Jesuit higher education and the Jesuit School of Theology preferred.
* Knowledge of ATS\-accredited graduate theological education preferred.

* Demons

new_jobs.description:
**Customer Care Representative**

  

**We are Lennar**

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for our Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

  

  

**A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future**

  

The Customer Care Representative is a key member of the Lennar Customer Care Team, providing warranty and service support to Homeowners through digital channels. The role is dedicated to enhancing Customer Satisfaction by responding to Homeowner service requests quickly and professionally using remote assessment, digital communication, and virtual technology. Clear and proactive communication with Homeowners, field teams, and Trade Partners is essential for timely and effective issue resolution.  



  

**Your Responsibilities on the Team**

* Professionally and promptly handle requests by contacting the Homeowner after reviewing provided documentation, homesite and case history to ensure familiarity with the matter.
* Use remote assistance tools to patiently guide Homeowners through troubleshooting, investigative and resolution steps.
* Share guidance on warranty coverage, out\-of\-warranty items, and self\-help solutions.
* Document and maintain all findings, including pertinent documents, photos, and correspondence using provided technology to ensure thorough case documentation.
* Determine the scope of work for warranty repairs, troubleshoot and resolve minor issues remotely, and coordinate with Trade Partners for further action.
* Ensure repairs are completed and Homeowners are satisfied through knowledgeable, friendly, and proactive support.
* Deliver comprehensive support in accordance with Lennar’s warranty policies and quality standards.
* Process back charges and EPOs to ensure prompt payment of Trade Partners as needed.
* Proactively remedy any trade partner scheduling, communication, or payment related issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned to support the overall success of the division.
  

  

**Your Toolbox**

* Minimum High School or GED required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Prior customer service experience required, preferably with a homebuilder.
* Must possess good organizational and time\-management skills, and understand technical aspects of residential construction.
* Able to analyze problems, determine solutions, and produce desired outcome.
* Intermediate to advanced PC skills (Microsoft Word and Excel).

Must possess professional attitude to represent company in a positive manner.  
* 

**Contacts**

  

Daily interaction with various division personnel, outside agencies, business partners, consultants and homeowners. Regular contact with the public. Frequent external contacts where matters discussed require resourcefulness, patience, clarity and tact.  



  

**Physical \& Office/Site Presence Requirements:**

  

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

**Summary**
-----------


The Advanced Medical Support Assistant (AMSA) in the San Francisco VA Healthcare System Call Center serves as part of an interprofessional healthcare team. AMSA provides support across multiple ancillary and interprofessional clinics and determines the needs of the Veteran/caregiver. The AMSA plays an integral role in achieving first\-contact resolution through Veteran\-centered delivery of care.  

  

**\*THIS IS NOT A REMOTE OR TELEWORK POSITION\*\***


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


NOTE: The 2\-page Resume requirement does not apply to this position.


  
**Duties**
----------


Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional  

  

The Advanced MSA provides specialized and expert administrative patient support while working collaboratively in an interprofessional coordinated care delivery model. Work involves specialized administrative judgment and the flexible use of a wide range of clinical flow processes relating to access to care across multiple clinics, specialties, and/or care in the community resources. Works collaboratively with VISN programs, services, and interprofessional coordinated care team members to provide access to care and meet the needs of Veterans via various available contact modalities to include but not limited to telephone calls, secure messaging, chat, text messaging and video. The AMSA is responsible for:


* Answers telephones, secure messages and chat messages, greeting patients, relaying messages to appropriate staff inside or outside of the Call Center, scheduling appointments, interpreting and verifying provider orders in accordance with VHA national scheduling guidelines.
* Recommends changes to existing clinic procedures based on current administrative guidelines.
* Expertise in utilizing numerous advanced patient systems in support of multiple clinics involved in an interprofessional coordinated care delivery model.
* Develops and/or maintains effective and efficient communication with the patient, interprofessional care delivery teams, VA medical centers, and other agencies; communicate with non\-VA medical facilities.
* Provides information and resolution to Veterans' requests within scope, uses administrative judgement to escalate symptomatic concerns to clinicians within the Call Center or directs the contact to the appropriate discipline within the Call Center or department for resolution.
* Uses advanced knowledge of health care process as it relates to access of care to ensure Veteran appointment scheduling is efficient, operational and prioritized to maintain Veteran flow and clinic readiness.
* Operates within the various contact modalities to receive and respond to incoming and outgoing contacts using computerized interfaces and telecommunications hardware and software.
* Provides accurate details of organizational information to Veterans regarding the different services the VA offers.
* Communicates tactfully and effectively to challenging customers who may be threatening, abusive, or distraught.
* Resolves Veteran complaints as appropriate. Performs duties as assigned to ensure efficient and effective operations.

------------


Since 1942, SkyChefs has taken culinary excellence to new heights. Built on a legacy of operational excellence, culinary expertise, and continuous innovation, we are committed to setting the industry standard in aviation culinary, airline services, last\-mile logistics, and retail commerce. From the kitchen to the runway, our teams work together to deliver quality, reliability, and service at every altitude. Our people are the heart of everything we do. At SkyChefs, a career is more than a job – it’s an opportunity to grow, lead, and make an impact in a fast\-paced, team\-driven environment. Join America’s first, foremost, and finest and take your career to new heights.**Role Purpose Statement**
--------------------------



The Equipment \& Sanitation (E\&S) Supervisor is responsible for overseeing equipment flow and deliveries to all departments, ensuring equipment is cleaned properly and delivered in a timely manner. This role plays a critical part in maintaining operational efficiency, food safety, and sanitation standards throughout the facility.

  

We are seeking a proactive leader who can balance people management, operational execution, and sanitation compliance while ensuring equipment availability and workflow efficiency across the operation.

**Main Accountabilities**
-------------------------


**How You'll Make a Difference**  

* Supervise, train, and schedule E\&S production staff to meet daily output goals.
* Monitor inventory levels, order supplies, and ensure proper maintenance of equipment.
* Identify bottlenecks, document processes, and implement improvements to enhance efficiency.
* Oversee the equipment and sanitation operations, maintaining quality control, and ensuring on\-time delivery
* Run daily huddles to keep everyone focused and energized
* Enforce strict adherence to HACCP, FDA, USDA, and OSHA regulations, ensuring proper temperature controls and hygiene.
* Optimize staffing and schedules to hit productivity and cost goals
* Implement innovative solutions to improve workflow and reduce waste
* Ensure every flight is catered accurately and on schedule
* Jump in on special projects and company initiatives to make an impact
* Motivate, coach, and develop your team while living our company values
**Leadership**

* Guide, motivate and develop staff within the Human Resources policies
* Make the company's values and management principles live in the department(s)
* Manage productivity hours and costs in the area of responsibility; initiate and steer corrective actions in case of deviations
* Participate and support company sponsored initiatives such as Quality, HACCP, Lean Manufacturing, Employee Safety and Production systems
**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
------------------------------------


* 1\-3\+ years in a food production environment
* Strong understanding of HACCP protocols, and food safety regulations.
* Excellent problem\-solving, leadership, and communication skills
* Experience with Microsoft Office and production management systems
* Experience leading teams and managing schedules in a manufacturing or distribution setting with a hands\-on, solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and lead under pressure in a deadline\-driven environment.

  

\#LSGNS

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager-CA
new_jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.


The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short\-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.


Essential Functions:


1\. Management


Lead others and work effectively with store crews


Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew


Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner


Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement


2\. Customer Service


Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints


Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**
Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.


Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill


Ability to work a full\-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise  



  

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**
High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**


40**Time Type**


Full time**Pay Range**


The typical pay range for this role is:


$23\.65 \- $37\.65
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

  

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**


We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.  

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

  

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/24/2026
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

new_jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About** **Nooks.ai****:**
===========================


Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from *account strategy* to *prospect research* and *outreach*. Building 0 1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.


Today, over 1,500 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We’ve raised $70M\+ from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, which made its first sales\-tech investment in over a decade with us. Since then, we’ve tripled ARR each year for 3 years running and grown a high\-caliber team turning the art of sales into a scalable science.

**Recruiting Operations Manager**
=================================


Nook's is looking for a Recruiting Operations Manager to help build the systems, programs, and infrastructure that enable our recruiting organization to scale.


This is a highly cross\-functional, high\-ownership role for someone who loves making things better. You’ll sit at the intersection of Recruiting, People, Marketing, and the broader business — using data, technology, AI, and strong program management to improve how we attract, engage, and hire great talent.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

### **1\. Recruiting Operations**

* Own recruiting processes, reporting, analytics, and operating rhythms.
* Turn recruiting data into insights and actionable improvements.
* Manage and optimize our recruiting technology and vendor ecosystem, including security, billing, adoption, and training.
* Research and implement new tools and technologies that improve recruiter productivity and candidate experience.
* Drive the adoption of AI across recruiting, including evaluating new use cases and implementing Nooks Agent.
* Lead strategic research projects to help us make better, data\-driven recruiting decisions.
* Help develop and strengthen Nooks’ recruiting/employer brand and equip the team with consistent messaging and tools.
* Create leverage across the recruiting team through better systems, automation, processes, and team enablement.

### **2\. Talent Events \& Programs**


Own or support talent\-focused events and programs that strengthen Nooks’ brand and talent pipeline, including:

* Hackathons and technical events
* Conferences and industry events
* Nooks\-hosted events and dinners
* University and community events
* Creative new ways to get Nooks in front of exceptional talent


Partner cross\-functionally with Marketing, Recruiting, Engineering, and other teams to maximize the impact of these efforts.

### **3\. People Operations Partnership**


Partner with People Operations to ensure Recruiting and People processes scale together.


You’ll help:

* Implement and communicate new processes effectively.
* Identify when teams need training, documentation, or enablement.
* Improve cross\-functional workflows and eliminate operational friction.
* Support strategic People projects where your expertise can create leverage.

### **4\. University Programs**


Own and accelerate Nooks’ university recruiting strategy, with a particular focus on engineering talent.


You’ll build relationships with universities and technical communities, develop programs and events, measure results, and create a scalable pipeline of exceptional early\-career talent. You’ll partner with recruiters and hiring teams as needed while maintaining ownership of the overall program.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience in Recruiting Operations, Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting, Program Management, or a similar function.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Experience building processes or programs from the ground up.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI and emerging recruiting technology.
* Ability to manage systems, vendors, and multiple cross\-functional initiatives.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* A bias toward action and a willingness to operate in ambiguity.
* Someone who naturally looks for ways to create leverage, automate work, and make teams better.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


You’ll make Nooks’ recruiting organization **more scalable, data\-driven, technology\-enabled, and effective**.


You’ll help us spend less time on manual work, make better decisions with better data, get more value from our technology, build a stronger talent brand, create new talent pipelines, and give the recruiting team the leverage they need to focus on what they do best: **hiring exceptional people.**

new_jobs.description:
Description:

If you're passionate about restoring California's natural landscapes and want to be involved in the entire restoration process from concept through implementation and long\-term success, this is an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact. As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you'll help lead and grow HELIX's expanding habitat restoration practice in Northern California while working alongside a team that designs, builds, monitors, and maintains restoration projects entirely in\-house.

**Why HELIX?**


At HELIX Environmental Planning, we take pride in delivering innovative environmental solutions that make a meaningful difference. Our team works on diverse public and private sector projects across California, from coastal habitats to mountain ecosystems and the Central Valley. What sets HELIX apart is our ability to handle every stage of habitat restoration under one roof, from planning and permitting to plant propagation, field implementation, and biological monitoring. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** role offers a unique chance to join a growing Northern California team and help shape the future of our restoration services. We offer a flexible hybrid work schedule with a combination of in\-office and remote work.

**Day in the Life**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, no two days are the same. You may start your morning collaborating with biologists and restoration practitioners on a large\-scale habitat restoration design, spend the afternoon evaluating a field site, and finish the day helping secure funding for future restoration efforts. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** works closely with regulatory agencies, field crews, project managers, and clients while helping lead restoration projects from planning through implementation and adaptive management.

**What You'll Do**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you will:

* Design and support habitat restoration projects to achieve project goals and success criteria.
* Lead site investigations and restoration feasibility assessments.
* Collaborate with field restoration crews during project implementation and adaptive management.
* Develop habitat restoration plans and support environmental permitting efforts.
* Assist with restoration grant applications and project development.
* Conduct and oversee biological surveys, vegetation mapping, and special\-status species surveys.
* Lead biological monitoring for restoration and construction projects.
* Support wetland permit applications and regulatory documentation.
* Participate in business development, proposal preparation, and project interviews.
* Travel occasionally overnight as project needs require.

**Compensation**


Salary will be based on qualifications and/or experience, with a robust benefits package. Expected starting pay range of **$130,000 to $160,000**.

**Ready to Grow Your Career?**


If you're an experienced **Senior Restoration Project Manager** looking to advance habitat restoration throughout Northern California while helping build and grow a thriving restoration program, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and join HELIX in creating positive environmental outcomes that last for generations.


HELIX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and an inclusive work environment. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of gender, race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or veteran status. These protections extend to all management practices and decisions, including recruitment and hiring, appraisal systems, promotions, training, and career development programs.


PM21


Requirements:
**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Botany, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of professional experience as a biologist, restoration ecologist, or restoration practitioner.
* At least 2 years of experience working in Northern California.
* Experience with field data collection methods and habitat restoration implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to hike long distances across varied terrain and weather conditions.
* Valid California Driver's License with a clean driving record.
* Ability to travel overnight occasionally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Environmental consulting experience.
* Society for Ecological Restoration CERP certification.
* ISA Arborist Certification.
* Wetland Delineation or Professional Wetland Scientist certifications.
* Experience coordinating with regulatory agencies.
* ArcGIS field data collection experience.
* Experience with plant propagation, equipment operation, or herbicide application.
* Experience leading biological surveys, monitoring programs, and environmental compliance efforts.

We launched publicly in Feb 2026, are already 65 people, and have strong early product\-market fit generating millions in ARR within months of launch. You'll have the chance to both scale our core systems and build new features from 0 to 1\.


We've raised $85M in our Series B from Founders Fund, Benchmark, and Human Capital, and our founders previously led Brex, Apollo, and Clari.


Come join us if you want to be part of a high autonomy, high pace team reinventing one of the biggest categories in enterprise software.

**The Role**
------------


You'll own post\-sales operations at Monaco and be the strategic partner to our launch operations and FDAE (post\-sales) teams. This is a senior RevOps hire with a post\-sales focus: you run the operational machinery that gets customers from signature to value, and you use data to tell leadership what's actually driving retention and expansion in a usage\-based business and how to implement it.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own GTM operations end to end for launch operations and post\-sales: onboarding, implementation, sales\-to\-post\-sales handoff, time\-to\-value, and the systems and processes the teams run on
* Find where customers stall in onboarding, fix the process, and measure the impact on activation and usage

* Partner with launch, FDAE (post\-sales), and CX leaders on operational projects and drive them to completion

**Who We're Looking For**

**Strong Pluses**

new_jobs.title: Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**  

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987\. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site\-based programs and community outreach.

 **POSITION PURPOSE**  

LifeMoves \| Eleven Eleven provides interim supportive housing in San Carlos to 39 individual veterans. During their stay, clients participate in holistic services tailored to each household’s unique needs and goals. Clients receive support to build self\-sufficiency and return to housing stability. The team supports clients with employment, housing, benefits, physical and behavioral health through case management, workshops, and connection to specialized resources.  



The Eleven Eleven Veteran Case Manager plays a key role in supporting people moving toward safe, stable housing and greater self\-sufficiency. This position provide case management services, life skills support, and resource connections. They work in partnership with clients to set goals, celebrate progress, and overcome challenges. Using a trauma\-informed and strengths\-based approach, this position builds trust and respect, making sure clients feel heard, valued, and supported throughout their journey.


Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high\-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.  



The Veteran Case Manager (VA CM) reports to the site Program Director and specializes in working with veterans experiencing homelessness. This role understands the unique experiences and strengths veterans bring and helps connect them to the right services, including veteran\-specific housing, employment, and health care programs. They advocate for each veteran’s needs and build strong community partnerships to offer the best support possible. Additionally, this role supports daily program operations and helps keep the site safe and welcoming for everyone. This role works closely with clients and staff to build a positive  

community, and helps monitor the environment, responds to client needs, and ensures that all program rules are followed with fairness and respect. Finally, this role supports service delivery by helping with client check\- ins, group activities, and site coordination.

 **ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

 **Client Support and Case Management**

* Develop, implement, and revise individual case plans with housing/employment/benefit/health and well being tasks based on client strengths and goals.
* Support clients with tasks including but not limited to housing searches, employment preparation, benefits access, life skills development, build resumes, cover letters, and navigate employment and housing resources.
* Support clients with enrollment into benefit programs including but not limited to General Assistance, CalFresh, and Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants.
* Coordinate with health care access to understand and support client physical and behavioral health needs.

Assist clients by scheduling medical appointments, arranging transportation, and accompanying them to appointments as needed.  
* 

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community partners by building strong relationships, connecting clients to needed resources and services, and educating the community on client needs and trauma\-informed care.
* Coordinate with relevant public partners, for example probation officers, Veterans Affairs, Adult Protective Services (APS), Child Protective Services (CPS) and city, state, and federal agencies, to support client needs and program goals.
* Client Advocacy, Mediation, and Conflict Resolution
* Serve as a liaison between clients and landlords, employers, or agencies to support successful outcomes.
* Provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
* Advocate for client rights and reduce stigma around homelessness and mental health challenges.
* Advocate for clients' needs and strengths when working with partners, landlords, employers, and other agencies.

 **Data Tracking and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records, case notes, reports, and program data in line with agency standards and confidentiality laws utilizing Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) and the LifeMoves internal client management system
* Track client progress, program outcomes, housing placements, employment and learning successes, and community partnerships.

**Crisis Management and Safety**


Provide crisis intervention and make referrals to appropriate services when needed.  

* 

**General Agency Responsibilities**

* Participate in weekly case conferences, monthly trainings, and regular supervision to strengthen skills.
* Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying what you learn to your daily work.
* Training expectations in the first 90 days of employment include but are not limited to CPR, Mental Health/First Aide (MHFA), Nonviolent Crisis Intervention

ChipAgents builds AI agents that help semiconductor engineers design and verify chips faster. We work with leading chip companies, cloud providers, and startups to improve the workflows behind RTL development, simulation, and verification.

Your job is to help the team move faster. We treat IT as an enabling function: remove friction, keep developers productive, and make everyday technology work reliably. Success means fast onboarding, quick resolution of issues, fewer interruptions, and tools that help people get their work done.  

You’ll be the primary point of contact for employee technology issues, taking ownership from the first report through resolution. You’ll also build the processes and automation that prevent recurring problems as the company grows.  

This is a hands\-on role with broad ownership and room to shape how IT operates at ChipAgents. You’ll bring practical judgment to security and reliability, choosing approaches proportionate to the risk and minimizing administrative overhead. new_jobs.description:
**About Coalfire**

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever\-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.

But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.

We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem\-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.  

**Position Summary**

The Advisory Senior Project Manager is a senior, client\-facing delivery leader responsible for planning, governing, and delivering complex consulting engagements from initiation through closeout. The role serves as the primary project management partner to clients, sponsors, and internal delivery teams, translating engagement objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes.



Working across Coalfire’s Cloud, Compliance Advisory, Cloud Maintenance \& Operations, and related consulting practices, the Senior Project Manager establishes delivery structure and manages scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality, and client commitments.



This role requires strong consulting presence, sound business judgment, executive communication, and the ability to operate independently in a matrixed environment. The Senior Project Manager leads through influence, brings transparency to delivery, and protects both the client experience and Coalfire’s delivery standards.



### **What You'll Do**



**CLIENT \& ENGAGEMENT LEADERSHIP**



* Serve as the primary project management point of contact for clients, sponsors, and internal delivery teams throughout the engagement.
* Build trusted client relationships through proactive communication, credible advice, reliable follow\-through, and a strong understanding of client objectives.
* Lead project initiation, discovery, kickoff, planning, execution, transition, and closeout activities for consulting engagements.
* Translate statements of work, engagement objectives, and client requirements into clear delivery plans, milestones, outcomes, and acceptance criteria.
* Set expectations regarding scope, schedule, budget, roles, decision rights, deliverables, assumptions, and escalation paths.
* Anticipate client needs and delivery risks, surface concerns early, and recommend practical options that support successful outcomes.
**PROJECT DELIVERY \& CONTROLS**



* Own the full project lifecycle for multiple concurrent client engagements, from initiation through delivery, transition, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans with appropriate detail to manage milestones, workstreams, dependencies, resources, deliverables, and critical path activities.
* Establish and maintain baselines for scope, schedule, budget, resources, and delivery milestones; assess and communicate variance.
* Coordinate work across matrixed consulting, technical, operational, and client teams to maintain delivery velocity and alignment.
* Define deliverable ownership, review cycles, acceptance criteria, and completion evidence; drive timely client approvals and sign\-offs.
* Manage scope and change control, including impact analysis, approvals, documentation, and communication of approved changes.
* Track project health using meaningful delivery metrics and provide clear recommendations when intervention or recovery planning is required.
* Ensure project documentation, decisions, action items, approvals, and status artifacts are complete, accurate, and maintained throughout the engagement.
**GOVERNANCE, RISK \& QUALITY MANAGEMENT**



* Design and manage an engagement governance model appropriate to the project’s size, complexity, client environment, and risk profile.
* Establish meeting cadences, forums, decision rights, escalation paths, reporting expectations, and stakeholder participation across the engagement.
* Maintain the RAID log and actively manage risks, assumptions, issues, decisions, dependencies, constraints, and mitigations through resolution.
* Lead governance reviews, stage gates, steering committee meetings, executive updates, and other formal delivery checkpoints.
* Prepare concise governance packs that communicate overall health, progress, decisions needed, risks, issues, financial status, and recommended actions.
* Escalate matters with sufficient context, impact analysis, options, and a recommended path forward; follow through until resolution or formal acceptance.
* Apply Coalfire delivery methodology, quality standards, and required controls; identify and address gaps before they affect client outcomes.
* Ensure engagements are delivered in accordance with applicable contractual commitments, internal policies, security expectations, and quality requirements.
**FINANCIAL \& COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT**



* Monitor project budgets, forecasts, burn, actuals, remaining effort, resource plans, and financial performance throughout the engagement.
* Partner with engagement and practice leadership to identify financial risks, forecast changes, and recovery actions.
* Track scope alignment and potential scope leakage; coordinate change requests and commercial impacts with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support accurate time, expense, invoicing, utilization, and revenue\-related processes in accordance with Coalfire requirements.
* Maintain visibility into resource capacity, staffing needs, delivery constraints, and planned transitions across the project lifecycle.
**STAKEHOLDER \& EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION**



* Provide clear, concise, and audience\-appropriate status reporting for clients, project teams, sponsors, practice leaders, and executives.
* Lead client status meetings, working sessions, steering committees, executive briefings, retrospectives

**About FiveBy**  

  

FiveBy is a high\-end anti\-fraud and online security consultancy headquartered in Seattle with operations across the United States. We are a fully remote consulting company of approximately 35 employees. We provide consulting services to help large and complex organizations address fraud, trust and safety, sanctions, compliance, and data challenges through experienced practitioners, disciplined delivery, and practical technology. With the ever\-increasing frequency of fraud, piracy, and other commercial risk, there has never been a better time to join the fight against online crime.

**The Opportunity**
===================


FiveBy is seeking a full\-time Practice Lead to own the performance, health, and growth of its fraud and trust and safety portfolio. This is FiveBy's senior operational and subject\-matter leadership role for the practice. The Practice Lead is accountable for executive client confidence, delivery quality, people leadership, account health, practice methods, and renewal readiness across major technology clients.


The role requires deep practical fraud expertise, strong people management, exacting quality standards, and calm judgment with senior clients. It guides service priorities and capacity and provides strategic and conceptual analytical frameworks to the delivery team, with technical fraud execution led by the senior delivery specialists. The Practice Lead contributes to growth by delivering work that earns renewals, identifying credible expansion opportunities, and helping shape solutions.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**Client and Engagement Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Own senior delivery relationships and executive client confidence across the portfolio, while dedicated program managers remain the primary day\-to\-day coordination contacts.
* Set engagement strategy, priorities, delivery capacity, team composition, coverage expectations, and material changes in direction in partnership with client leaders and FiveBy program managers.
* Lead major client escalations and crises, bringing consequential account decisions to resolution with the appropriate FiveBy and client stakeholders.
* Oversee scope, staffing, commitments, account health, and delivery risk. Surface margin, capacity, and renewal concerns early.

**Delivery Quality and Fraud Expertise**
----------------------------------------

* Set quality standards and make the final determination that client\-facing work is accurate, complete, clear, and defensible before release.
* Provide senior oversight and practical guidance on fraud strategy, program maturity, operating models, investigations, controls, and mitigation approaches.
* Contribute directly to complex investigations, pattern analysis, detection signal design, heuristics, and program\-level decisions when senior judgment is needed.
* Provide strategic and analytical frameworks for ambiguous fraud and operational questions, relying on technical leads when specialized domains fall outside the role's deepest expertise.

**People and Practice Leadership**
----------------------------------

* Manage, coach, and develop Client Leads and Principal Consultants, and ensure effective people management throughout each client team.
* Build a stable, high\-performing team by clarifying roles, addressing performance concerns promptly, retaining key employees, and developing future leaders.
* Define and improve the practice's service offerings, delivery methods, staffing criteria, quality controls, and reusable tools.
* Turn lessons from engagements into practical FiveBy intellectual property, including playbooks, templates, investigation methods, fraud heuristics, and detection frameworks.

* Represent the practice in FiveBy leadership discussions and contribute to company strategy, capability planning, and resource decisions.

**Growth and Market Leadership**

* Earn renewal readiness through strong execution and clear client value and identify useful expansion opportunities within client relationships and bring them to the sales team to shape and pursue.
* Contribute fraud expertise to solution design, proposals, statements of work, and executive presentations while respecting the commercial owner's responsibility for pricing, contracting, and negotiation.
* Strengthen FiveBy's reputation through thoughtful industry participation, relationship development, and practical thought leadership in fraud and trust and safety.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Required Experience and Capabilities**
----------------------------------------

* Fifteen or more years of experience in fraud operations, fraud risk management, trust and safety, payments risk, online security, or a related field.
* At least four years in consulting, professional services, or an advisory role with responsibility for senior client relationships and delivery outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience building or leading a fraud program, team, or practice and managing experienced professionals. A record of developing leaders, retaining critical employees, and addressing performance concerns directly and fairly.
* Deep practical knowledge of fraud programs, investigations, controls, operations, and relevant fraud types, such as account abuse, promotional and referral fraud, synthetic identity, payment and chargeback fraud, and coordinated abuse.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to frame ambiguous strategic and operational problems.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to review and produce executive\-ready work and represent FiveBy credibly with senior clients.
* A bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.
* A full\-time, multi\-year commitment to building FiveBy's primary growth practice.

new_jobs.description:
**Business Operations / Marketing Coordinator**

Victory Programming LLC provides CMM programming, training, and support to manufacturers using Zeiss coordinate measuring machines. We're looking for an organized, proactive, detail\-oriented Business Operations / Marketing Coordinator to help us run and grow the business.

This role works directly with the CEO/owner and is meant to grow into a trusted, highly capable extension of the CEO — someone who takes ownership of business processes, spots problems, and solves them, not just completes assigned tasks.

Remote, but Minnesota preferred (Central MN or Twin Cities area) for occasional in\-person meetings. Part\-time, approximately 20 hours/week, flexible schedule, with potential to grow into full\-time.

**The Opportunity**

The CEO's highest\-value work is complex CMM programming, coaching customers, building training resources, and creating time\-saving tools. This role is meant to take on the day\-to\-day operations work so the CEO can focus there. Expect a mix of customer coordination, Zoho workflow improvements, prospect follow\-up, video editing, research, and finding better ways to handle recurring tasks.

**Responsibilities**

* **Business Operations \& Admin:** Manage calendars, scheduling, email, and phone communications; coordinate customer onboarding (NDAs, forms, POs, scheduling); handle business travel and file organization; follow up on invoices, quotes, and action items; coordinate freelancers/vendors; handle research and admin projects
* **Customer Communication \& Project Coordination:** Serve as a routine point of contact; communicate professionally by email/phone; judge when CEO involvement is needed; help manage projects start to finish
* **Marketing \& Business Development:** Run email marketing (Zoho Campaigns); research prospects and opportunities; manage YouTube channel (editing/publishing) and social media; recommend website improvements; develop tutorial content and a knowledge base
* **Technology \& Process Improvement:** Maintain/improve Zoho Creator and CRM systems; identify and automate inefficient processes; research new tools; support WordPress/Wix site upkeep
* **Financial \& Other Support:** Maintain financial records; help prep info for taxes; support AR and financial\-process automation; own problems through to completion; other duties as needed

**What We're Looking For**

*Character:* Truthful, humble, a good listener, self\-motivated, dependable, detail\-oriented but able to see the big picture, resourceful, comfortable admitting what they don't know, discreet with confidential information, committed to doing things right rather than just checking boxes. Character and ability to learn matter more than experience with any specific system.

*Organization \& Communication:* Strong organizational, time\-management, and communication skills; able to juggle priorities with minimal supervision; professional with customers and vendors; good judgment on what needs CEO attention.

*Technology:* Comfortable learning new tools; ideally some experience with Microsoft Office/Outlook/Teams, Zoom, Zoho Creator/CRM/Books/Campaigns, WordPress/Wix, YouTube Studio, AI tools like ChatGPT, and cloud file management. Zoho Creator experience is a plus but not required — we'll train the right person.

*Industry Experience:* Background in manufacturing, engineering, quality, metrology, CMMs, CAD, aerospace, or medical manufacturing is a plus but not required. You don't need to be a CMM expert.

**Level of Responsibility**

This role is designed to grow. The CEO will provide more direction early on; as you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and understanding of the business, you'll take on more decision\-making authority — eventually owning substantial parts of day\-to\-day operations and customer communication. We're looking for someone who brings solutions, not just problems.

**Schedule \& Compensation**

* \~20 hrs/week initially, flexible schedule, weekday business hours, no weekends required
* Remote; Minnesota preferred; occasional in\-person meetings in Central MN/Twin Cities
* Potential to grow into full\-time
* $30–$45/hour based on experience — strong Zoho Creator, ops, marketing, or automation experience qualifies toward the upper end
* No benefits at part\-time status; may be considered if the role becomes full\-time

**What Success Looks Like**

Routine operations run smoothly without constant direction; customer communications, projects, and follow\-ups stay on track; CRM data stays accurate; inefficiencies get identified and fixed; marketing runs consistently; problems come with solutions attached — freeing the CEO to focus on CMM programming, coaching, and building new tools.

**Why This Might Be a Good Fit**

A chance to learn how a specialized technical business runs, take on real responsibility, and shape the role as you grow into it.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

 **About the role:**


As a **Sales Account Manager**, you will play a pivotal role in achieving sales targets and driving the growth of BSI America’s product and service offerings related to ISO standards and certifications.  **In your day to day, you will be responsible for:**

* **Client Relationship Management**: Foster strong relationships with clients, ensuring continuous business growth and repeat engagements.

* **Accurate Reporting**: Provide timely and accurate sales reports, supporting business forecasting and strategy development.
* **Travel for Success**: Travel to visit clients on a quarterly basis, building personal connections and furthering business opportunities.

* **Sales Experience**: At least four years of experience in sales.
* **Industry Knowledge**: Familiarity with the certification industry and/or ISO standards is a plus, though not essential.

* **Collaboration Mindset**: Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and external partners.

* **Valid Driver's License**: Travel to client sites is required on a quarterly basis.

This position offers a base annual salary plus a great commission structure; actual compensation is based on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s competencies, level of experience, education, location, divisional budget, and internal peer compensation comparisons.

new_jobs.title: Client Executive - Private Client Services (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
Alliant Insurance Services is one of the nation’s largest and fastest\-growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms. We operate through a network of specialized national platforms and local offices to offer our clients a comprehensive portfolio of solutions built on innovative thinking and personal service. Alliant is changing the way our clients approach risk management and benefits, so they can capitalize on new opportunities to grow and protect their organizations.
  
**More information is available on the company's website at:** www.alliant.com.
  
  

SUMMARY
  
  

Acts as an agent of broker\-assigned accounts for Private Client Services, including servicing and/or solicitation activities. Manages book of business and directs the work of a service team.
  
  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Receive and develop new business leads from Producers, or identify and develop cross\-sell opportunities.
  
  

Responsible for renewal business and soliciting additional lines of coverage.
  
  

Evaluate assigned client coverage portfolio to implement cross\-selling opportunities and solicit additional lines of coverage.
  
  

Service accounts and provide claims support as needed.
  
  

Analyze exposure base to identify program deficiencies and develop proper marketing strategies.
  
  

Complete applications, obtain quotes, negotiate premiums and commissions, and prepare proposals and presentations.
  
  

Bind coverage, identify deficiencies, and determine appropriate level of coverage.
  
  

Meet with clients as needed or as directed by Producer.
  
  

Review accounting history, respond to accounting inquiries, correct discrepancies, and contact clients on receivable collections.
  
  

Serve as technical expert, assist department members to resolve complex issues.
  
  

Handle collection of fees, reconciling and resolving any outstanding balances within 90 days of invoicing.
  
  

Comply with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enter and maintain complete and accurate information).
  
  

Other duties as assigned.
  
  

QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE
  
  

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
  
  

Eight (8\) or more years of Private Client/High Net\-Worth insurance servicing experience required
  
  

Valid insurance license
  
  

Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal
  
  

SKILLS
  
  

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
  
  

Knowledge of a wide array of private client customizable coverages
  
  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
  

Good problem\-solving and time management skills
  
  

Good planning, organizational, and prioritization skills
  
  

Strong interpersonal skills
  
  

Ability to build trust and de\-escalate concerns
  
  

Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork
  
  

Ability to maintain confidentiality
  
  

\#LI\-DR2
  
  

\#LI\-REMOTE
  
  

We are proud to provide comprehensive, high quality employee programs to meet employees' needs now and in the future, including a very competitive financial package. We encourage you to explore what we have to offer.
  
  

For immediate consideration for this position, please click on the "Apply" button.
  
  

Alliant Insurance Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on their qualifications and ability without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, age, genetic information, or status as a protected veteran, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including California law.
  
  

Applicants are protected under Federal law from discrimination. If you need an accommodation to complete the application process or would like to review these materials in an alternative format, please reach out to Careers@Alliant.com
  
  

For more information on Alliant Insurance Service's benefits, please visit www.alliant.com/about/careers/benefits
